Your grandfather asked me to accompany you to Monsignor Quentinus in Hillbrandt. Shall we go?

I know and respect the wish of my grandfather. But I think it's not wise of him. I'm a great support to him. How could he live here without me? And how could I live without him? I do not know anyone in Hillbrandt... But what can I do? I respect his decision.
Great, so let's go. It's a long way.
Good day, good woman.
Good day, sir knight. How are you? Do you think the end of the world is really at hand? Now, when our King is dead, all those terrible rumors seem much more real to me...
I don't know, child. But I trust that until we're dead we may strive to change it!
Thank you, knight.
Who are you, child?
My name is Adeleida, knight. I'm the granddaughter of royal chamberlain Trisstan.
I'm pleased to meet you. May I ask you a few questions?
I'm sorry, knight, but I would not tell you much. Do not be angry with me.
Alright. Farewell.
Good day, knight. I'm happy to see you.
Me too, child. May I ask you a few questions?
Do not be angry with me, knight, but I wouldn't tell you much...
Good day, knight. It's nice to see you. I thank you for accompanying me to Hillbrandt. I hope I'll get used to this town.
I hope so. May I ask you a few questions?
I'm sure you will. Good luck!
Thank you, knight. Farewell.
A paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous steals?! It's unbelievable! No wonder this world is in such a bad state when even God's knights are thieves! Shame!
Good day, Father. How are you? May I ask you for a blessing?
Sure, child. I bless you in the name of God Almighty. Amen.
Thank you, Father.

Could I see your goods?
Sure! We in the Royal Alchemist Guild sell only the best stuff!
Nothing for now, thanks.
In that case you must excuse me, knight, I have to return to my experiments. It seems those plums are starting to distillate...
I welcome you in the Royal Alchemist Guild, knight. And I ask you not to touch anything, because there are important alchemical experiments in progress here!
For example what?
For example the distillation of plums. It's a complicated alchemical experiment that should result in the discovery of an elixir of eternal healthiness and happiness...
And if unsuccessful?
Well... then we will get slivovitz as usual... But such is the nature of science. What can I do for you?
I understand. And I admire your zeal for science...
Thank you, knight. It's really hard work—you sure can imagine that. What can I do for you, as the representative of the Royal Alchemist Guild?
Sure, I won't touch anything...
I'm glad to hear that. What can I do for you?
Hello, knight. What can I do for you? And beware of that burner over there—your clothes could catch fire...

Who rules here in Alvaron?
Ruler of Alvaron is Grand Duke Drake Lambert, the royal governor of this town. Duchess Vanessa of Kenthworth is the vice-governor.
I'm sorry, I'm not going to talk about that with you!
I have heard some rumors about a coming war. Do you happen to know anything about that?

People say there will be a war. At least everything indicates it—horses and cattle are being requisitioned, granaries are being filled up and young men recruited to the army... Just one thing is missing, and quite a significant one—an enemy. There is no sign the realm is being endangered by an enemy that our army could stand against in a field. It's really strange and people are scared—war is the last thing we would like to have!
Has there recently been a fierce storm in Alvaron accompanied by unnatural phenomenon?

I do not remember any recent fierce storm. It's true that sometimes the sky above Alvaron is going wild and you can see things man would not believe to exist, but recently? No, I don't remember any fierce storms.
What monsters may I come across here?

You're asking really the right one about the monsters. Were it not for you I myself would have changed into one of those monstrous toothy wolf-beasts... You can't imagine how strong the calling of wolf-prince Wulfhyrr was. It resounded in my heart like the treacherous whisper of Satan the tempter. Just a bit longer and I would become one of the werewolves of the Wulfhyrr's pack, which all Alvaron is scared of. I can't imagine running with them on bloody hunts killing innocent victims. I can't imagine preying upon lonely pilgrims wandering at night. How disgusting!
Is it possible to get any reward here in Alvaron for killing a monster?

There are high rewards for werewolves who rage not only in the vicinity of the city, but even in the streets. Sheriff Henry Portmann will pay rewards in exchange for the trophies you give him—werewolf heads. I shiver all over when I remember that it could easily be my head that someone would get pouch of gold for...
I search for heretics here in Alvaron. Have you any suspicions?

I'm sorry, knight, but I won't help you with hunting of heretics and witches. I try to stay away from heresy, because it's like a plague—you can catch it without even knowing. But if I hear or see something I surely will tell you, you can count on it!
Have anything noteworthy happened here in Alvaron in recent days?

During the last few years quite a lot of people have been brutally murdered, knight. And at least equal number has gone missing without a trace. People usually pin it on the packs led by wolf-prince Wulfhyrr, and I too sincerely believe it to be true. Werewolves have been living in this country since the times immemorial, but in the last three years their numbers increased so much they even dare to hunt during the day. Someone should do something about it...
I'm investigating the case of false gold. It seems some heretics are able to temporarily change human ordure into gold. Do you know anything about it?
You should ask my wife Salena about the false gold. She told me she herself had seen that gold, so she may be able to help you...
I search for missing Ron Burton. Do you happen to know anything about him?
I'm sorry, but I don't know a thing about Ron Burton. I even didn't know he is missing...
Priest Nicolas states he was wrongfully alleged of raping Grand Duchess Liana Lambert. Do you know anything about it?

It's true that there are many rumors about Grand Duchess Liana Lambert. For example, that she cheats on her husband at every turn and that she is a perverted, wanton woman dominated by an uncontrollable lust. But this is not something you would say aloud about the royal governor's wife, is it?!
That's all, farewell.
Of course I don't want it for free...
If you really want to know that, knight, it will cost you $$moneypopTargetPop$$ gp.
All right.
I don't have that much.
In that case I can't help you...
I won't give you that much!
I'll give you no more than 10 gp.
Answer me at once, good man, or you will come to know the terrors of God's wrath!
I sincerely ask you to answer my question, good man. I assure you it will help to administer God's justice!
I find it hard to believe such a knowing and world-wise man would refuse to answer such a simple question...
Alright, nothing...

Really? My God, at last someone will help me! Thank you, knight. I... damn... what is it?... Aaaargh... the pain... I can't see anything, the red haze, it's everywhere! What's happening? Wrrrggghhhhh...
The disease is progressing... Drink the potion, good man, and fast!

Take that ugly slop away, knight! You will not need it anymore, and so won't I! Why should I drink it?! New being has been born inside me. I'm the beast ready to kill! I'm Ulghurff, master of the night. I've arisen to bring sacrifices to our god Urr. And I hear him asking me for your life. Yes, my lord, I'll kill him at once! Whhrraauugghh!
I can see that I'm going to have to use force to overcome your resistance and compel you to drink the potion. Apparently there is no other way... it seems to be God's will. So, let's do it...

Go away from me, knight! Fast! I can't resist it for long. It engulfs me. I may rush on you any moment now and tear your throat open to quench that ardent thirst which is consuming me... Go away... run... Save your life!
You are Alwar Flock, right? Your wife asked me to try to help you...

Salena? My beloved Salena is still trying to help me, even after I almost killed her? I love her so much... But it's too late, knight. Soon I'm going to become a werewolf, to join the pack of those ugly beasts and then I will feast on human flesh like them. It's too late...
I assure you it is not. I have a potion with me that will cure you of lycanthropy once and for all!
I assure you it is not. I'll get you a medicine that will help you!
In that case please hurry, knight. I don't know how long I can resist it...
Good God... you are changing into a werewolf?!

Yes, it's true... Some time ago I was attacked by a pack of werewolves while hunting near the city. I managed to get away only thanks to God's providence, but those beasts bit me. Since that time I've been hearing their calling, they lure me, they want me to join the pack. And my body is changing, smitten by that ugly disease. Look at me, knight—I almost do not resemble a human now!
Knight... the pain is consuming me. I feel the taste of my own blood on my lips and it's driving me mad! I yearn for fresh blood... I want to rip someone to pieces! Do something!
You must bear it a little longer, good man. I still have not managed to get the medicine...
Hurry, knight! Don't you see how fast the transformation is progressing? Better go away, heat of your body drives me mad...
I have a potion for you that will cure your lycantrophy once and for all.
Whauuuuuuuffff... urgh... urgh...
I told you I can overcome your resistance... Now I'm going to pour the potion into your mouth and then pray it works. Because if it won't, I'll have to kill you like a wild animal!
Whufff... Aaahhhh... the pain... it's unbearable... Aaahhhh...
Good heavens... the potion really works! You're starting to look like human again, good man!
My God... I'm cured! I'm human again! You have done it, knight!
Yes, it seems so. It was the will of God.
I'm in your debt. I'll be thankful till the day I die. Were it not for you I would have changed into a bloodthirsty beast killing innocent people at night. Thank you, thank you with all my heart.
You should thank your wife, good man. It was she who asked me to help you.

Yes, that's true. My beloved Salena had not forsaken me even in such a gruesome condition. I must go to her, knight. I must go to her and thank her with all my heart. And then I will gulp down some food—I'm hungry as a wolf!
Good day, knight. Me and my wife are really glad to see you. Were it not for you we would not have been together now!
I'd like to talk with you, good man.
As you wish, knight. What have you to say?
I'd like to know how you are faring. If there are any... after-effects.
No, knight. The potion you gave me cured me. My body changed back. Only... I've been hungry since then and that hunger can be satisfied only by a bloody piece of rare meat.
Well...
Do not worry, knight—I'll take care of myself. If it should get worse I would rather run into the woods than hurt someone...
Nothing, I just came by. Goodbye.
