As you clearly don't want to cooperate, I have no other choice but to use force!
Hello, knight. Have you already done anything about that witch Jeanette? I'm horrified of the moment she will appear at my doorstep again and will try to bewitch me...
I have a good piece of news for you, Brookwelt. Jeanette is dead. I had to kill her, because she opposed me.
Dead? Oh, good. God punished her through you for her sins! Thank you. God is my witness that you saved many lives. Take this pouch for your willingness. It's not much, but it's all I have.
Thank you. Could I ask you several question now?
But of course, knight. I'd like to help you howsoever. What's the matter?
Farewell, Brookwelt.
No, Brookwelt, Jeanette hasn't been punished yet. You have to hold on.
In that case don't hesitate, knight. I'm scared that she will try something again. After all, I'm a troublesome witness to her...
You can rely on me. But now I need to talk to you for a moment, if it's possible.
No, Brookwelt, Jeanette hasn't been punished yet. And she won't be. I'm inclined to believe her testimony. It is you who is the sorcerer in a need to be taken to the trial!

That devil's whore bewitched you! You're under her command and you believe all she says to you! But she won't get rid of me so quickly, not of me! I'm not going to let them execute me for something I didn't do! Never! I'd rather die than get into the hands of inquisitors. But you, knight, you I will take with me!
What do you want from me, knight?
The answers, Brookwelt. I want some answers from you.
Ask your questions, if you must. What else can I do...
Nothing. Farewell.
Hello, knight. How do you do? Thanks for the help with that crazy witch. No one needs to be afraid of her anymore.
I'd like to ask you several questions, Brookwelt.
So, ask your questions, knight. Maybe I'll be of some use to you.
You were right, Brookwelt. Jeanette really was a witch. She attacked me as well and I had to kill her. She won't bother you again.
I told you so, knight... But thanks for taking care of her, I will be able to sleep much better now.

Alright. The game called The King and the Groom is played with two dice—the result of your roll is usually a simple number or it can be a special one, which is called a figure. The lowest standard value of a roll is three and one—that is also a figure called Groom. Then follow other numbers, and the resulting value of the roll is counted by multiplying the higher number rolled by ten and adding the lower number to it. So, when you roll three and two, you have thirty-two, four and one give forty-one and so on. The highest value possible is sixty-five. If you roll two of the same numbers, it is a figure called Chamberlain. And the numbers on the dice tell how many Chamberlains there are. If you roll two ones, there is one Chamberlain. If you roll two twos, you have two Chamberlains and so on. But the highest figure in this game is the King, which is composed of one and the two. There is nothing higher; it is the absolute trump. That's why the game is called The King and the Groom—the Groom is the lowest roll and the King is the highest. Do you understand?

Sure I do, noble sir! They confiscated all my horses, cows and even oxes because of the war! And they seized half of my supplies that I bought this Spring. And that's not all—they even came to ask me to enlist! I do not know against whom this war is to be waged, because there has not been any enemy seen marching—it came out of the blue. As soon as King Edward died don Rodrigo de Velacor commanded all the royal regiments in the entire Realm to make ready for fighting. People of Alvaron are alarmed and it does not surprise me at all...

Wait, noble sir. I'd like to thank you for the money you have selflessly lent me. It was very generous of you. It helped me to overcome certain troubles and repay a debt that was distressing me greatly.
Farewell, noble sir.
What would you like, noble sir?
As you wish, noble sir. It will be one gp.
You're welcome, noble sir. I thought priests do not revel in drinking, though, but it's not my problem. Can I do anything else for you?
Here you go, noble sir. It will be one gp.
Mead? As you wish, noble sir... Here you go, noble sir. It will be one gp.
Here you are, noble sir. It's free. Can I do something else for you?
Here you are, noble sir. It will cost you 1 gp.
In that case you surely understand I won't serve you any more, noble sir. I'm sorry, but I don't sell on credit!
You're welcome, noble sir. May I do something else for you?
In that case you surely understand I won't serve you any more, noble sir. I'm sorry, but I don't sell on credit! What else can I do for you?
Here you are, noble sir. It's free for you. Can I do something else for you?

I'm sorry, noble sir, but I won't serve you any more drinks. Somebody might accuse me of tempting you to sin. You know how difficult these times are. And you are a priest after all. So, what else can I do for you?
Here you are, noble sir. Roll. You have to roll better than I did.
So what have you rolled, noble sir?
And you lose, noble sir. I really rolled it, see?
You win, noble sir. I didn't roll it...
Forty-one, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Forty-two, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Forty-three, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Fifty-one, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Fifty-two, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Fifty-three, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Fifty-four, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Sixty-one, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Sixty-two, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Sixty-three, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Sixty-four, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Sixty-five, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
One Chamberlain, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Two Chamberlains, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Three Chamberlains, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Four Chamberlains, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Five Chamberlains, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
Six Chamberlains, noble sir. Do you believe me or not?
The King, noble sir. I've the King. Do you believe me or not?
I'm sorry, noble sir, I can't play on. I've lost enough to stay away from gambling for some time. Goodbye.
In that case come when you have at least 10 gp, noble sir. Farewell.
As you wish, noble sir. How much do you want to wager?
I'm afraid you can't play then, noble sir. Come when you have at least 10 gp. Farewell.
I'm sorry, noble sir, but I won't play on. I've lost enough already to keep away from gambling for some time. Farewell.
As you wish, noble sir. Farewell.
If you think so, noble sir... what are you aiming at?
Tell me, noble sir, have his murderers been punished?
In that case I ask you to perform your bound duty, noble sir!
I count on you, noble sir. But now tell me, if I may be of help somehow.

Really? So then his death is avenged. That's good. Now my brother will find eternal peace at last. Thank you, noble sir. I'm indebted to you. If it won't displease you, I'd like to give you this pouch as an expression of my gratitude and to cover your expenses associated with this case.

No, I thank you, noble sir. My brother is avenged and nothing else matters. I will pray for his soul. But let's not dwell in such a gloomy mood. It won't give me my brother back. You better tell me if I can do something for you.

You are very generous, noble sir. Thank you. My brother is avenged and that's the only thing that matters. I will pray for him. But let's not dwell in such a gloomy mood. It won't give me back my brother. You better tell me if I can do something for you.

You are a noble, aren't you, sir? If it is so, then I'd like to report the murder of my brother Ron Burton. He was to return from a business trip to Glatzburg, but he didn't come back because he was murdered!
My name is Burton, noble sir. William Burton. And this is my inn. Or OUR inn, if I count my poor brother. But as I told, I'm convinced he is already gone to the big bar above.

No, noble sir, he is dead. Murdered. He always was accurate and punctual, nothing could delay him. He was just the same as our departed father. But that's not the main reason I think he was murdered. I saw his ghost! He came during the night and besought me to avenge his death. I had my heart in my mouth, but right the next day I started to search the city for any information about him. In the end I was so desperate as to visit the ill-famed ale-house of Salena Flock and there in her shop luck smiled at me—I found some things that surely belonged to my brother!

Yes, noble sir, I would be very grateful to you. I'm sure my brother is dead, and if he was murdered, I want justice to be administered! I want his murderers to suffer for their deeds. I want them to die on the gallows and their souls to be ripped to pieces by demons in the fires of Hell!
Thank you, noble sir. Can I do something for you now? Do you wish to buy something? Or maybe something to eat or drink?

Hmm... I understand, noble sir. I will have to investigate it myself. I won't let my brother's death go unavenged, I swear! But I won't trouble you with it anymore, noble sir. What can I do for you? Do you wish to buy anything? Or to have something to eat or to drink?

I do not know, noble sir. I can't rule out such a possibility. But maybe it was just the usual robbing murder. There are many of them these days, darn it all! Ehm, forgive me for cursing so, but I can't help myself. I liked my brother a lot!
Welcome, noble sir. Do you bring me any news about my brother? Have his murderers been found and brought to justice?
I see. It probably won't be easy to catch and punish the murderer of my brother. Still, I'm confident you will succeed in it, noble sir. You must!
I have complete confidence in you, noble sir. But now tell me if I can do anything for you.
Good day, noble sir. What can I do for you? Do you want to buy some wares, or have you come to get something to eat or drink?
Do you bring me good news, noble sir? Have the murderers of my brother been punished?
Good day, noble sir. I thank you once more for sheding light on the murder of my brother. I hope his soul has found eternal peace... Can I do something for you?
I won't let you do this, spawn of Hell!

And how do you want to stop me, mortal? You don't think you are able to, do you? You cannot stop me any more than you may force water to stop flowing! But as you wish—you decided it. I will gratify myself on your wrenched entrails!
I banish you, demon, to go away from this world and never to return!

I'm sorry, mortal, but I like it here and so I'm going to stay. There are so many yearning hearts here bound by absurd restraints and I want to help them get free. I want to help you all to release yourself from the rigid commandments, which prevent you from understanding the true passion! That's why I will stay here and will endow mortals with my love!
Those who summoned you to this world were already rightfully punished, demon. And your fate will be just the same!

You don't seem to understand you are unable to destroy me, mortal. I have come to help you all to release yourself from the rigid commandments, which prevent you from understanding the true passion! There are so many yearning hearts here bound by absurd restraints and I want to help them to get free. That's why I will stay here!
I'm afraid I cannot let you do that. This world does not care for your pleasures...

I would not be so sure of it, mortal. Look around yourself and tell me if the world really is full of silently meditating beings raised high above their imperfect mortal frames. Tell me if mortals desire for spiritual purity. No, my dear, it's not so. Mortals hunger for passion I bring them. They starve for unrestrained wild lust for which they would do anything. And that's exactly what they will get!

Come closer, mortal. I've been awaiting you. I've been feeling your presence in my realm long before you entered my chambers. Come closer and love me! I will give you such pleasures that you will not forget this day till your death. You will get to know such secrets of lust that you'll be unable to force your lips away from my breasts! Together we will open the gates of the original sin!
Dear God! Succubus Cerdie! So it's really true! The Fallen Angel has entered our world!

Yes, it's just as you said. I've entered your world in all my perfection. No more will I have to send my emissaries to secretly fill the hearts of men and women with daydreams of pleasures they are looking for. The day of eternal debauchery is come!
Dear God! Succubus Cerdie!

Yes, it's me, mortal. I'm glad even you recognized me. I presume you've dreamt of me—sometime. Everybody dreams of me every now and then. And now I have entered this world to give you all you desire. No more will I have to send my emissaries to secretly fill your hearts with daydreams of pleasures you are looking for. The day of eternal debauchery has come!

My name is Eradim d'Chambrie and I am a commander of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. But it does not matter. It is much more important that I've been led astray and became a member of the cult called the Children of the New Order!
God forgive your soul! Do you want to expiate your sin? Do you want to confess and remedy the evil you've committed?
Exactly, brother. I want to confess and entrust my soul to God to decide if I may pass through purgatory and then enter the Kingdom of Heaven, or if I will suffer forever in the fires of Hell...
I understand and commend your decision. Well, tell me all and speak truthfully. Conceal nothing!

Yes, you have my word I will speak the truth and nothing else, God help me. I've sinned, brother. I was accosted by a false prophet and pulled into the darkness. I committed terrible crimes by which even I am horrified. I... WAIT! What was that? Did you hear that sound? Somebody is watching us!
No, I didn't hear anything.
But yes, there is somebody here! I hear silent steps coming. Don't you hear them?
No, I don't... But wait! Now I heard something too. Or didn't I?

Yes, you did. Somebody is here. Let's go away, brother. I fear they are coming. They want to stop me. But I won't let them! I will tell you all about their crimes! I will denunciate them all to a man! Nobody will stop me... Watch out! It's an arrow! Cover yourself! Aaaaahhhhh!
What's the matter with you, brother? My God, you are bleeding... Lie down, fast!
Do you hear me, brother? Say something! Damned! You must not die now! Tell me everything you know!
It's hopeless... he is dead. I have to found his murderer. Perhaps I can use the arrow that killed the paladin. I've never seen a similar one!
Brother, I have to speak with you. I can be silent no more. Please, listen to me. I'd like to make a confession!
Who are you, brother? And what crimes do you want to confess to?
I'm sorry, brother, but I have no time for you. Go confess to somebody else.
No, brother, I must tell it only to you. I know who you are and what you are searching for. I know all about the Children of the New Order!
Just so, Father. I want to confess and entrust my soul to God to decide if I may pass through the purgatory and then enter the Kingdom of Heaven, or if I will forever suffer in the fires of Hell...

Yes, you have my word I will speak the truth and nothing else, God help me. I've sinned, Father. I was accosted by a false prophet and pulled in the darkness. I committed terrible crimes by which even I am horrified. I... WAIT! What was that? Did you hear that sound? Somebody is watching us!
But yes, someone is watching us! I hear silent steps coming. Don't you hear them?

Yes, you did. Someone is watching us. Let's go away, Father. I fear they are coming. They want to stop me. But I won't let them! I will tell you all about their crimes! I will denunciate them all to a man! Nobody will stop me... Watch out! It's an arrow! Cover yourself! Aaaaahhhhh!
What's the matter with you, knight? My God, you are bleeding... Lie down, fast!
Do you hear me, knight? Say something! Damned! You must not die now! Tell me everything you know!
Father, I have to speak with you. I can be silent no more. Please, listen to me. I'd like to make a confession!
Who are you, knight? And what happened so grave you have to confess immediately?
I'm sorry, knight, but I have no time for a confession. Go to priests in the temple, they will be glad to hear your confession
No, Father, I must tell it only to you. I know who you are and what you are searching for. I know all about the Children of the New Order!
And you seem to regret it now, am I right? Do you want to save your skin by denunciating others?
Exactly, sir. I want to confess and entrust my soul to God to decide if I may pass through purgatory and then enter the Kingdom of Heaven, or if I will suffer forever in the fires of Hell...

Yes, you have my word I will speak the truth and nothing else, God help me. I was accosted by a false prophet and pulled into the darkness. I committed terrible crimes by which even I am horrified. I... WAIT! What was that? Did you hear that sound? Somebody is watching us!

Yes, you did. Somebody is here. Let's go away, sir. I fear they are coming. They want to stop me. But I won't let them! I will tell you all about their crimes! I will denunciate them all to a man! Nobody will stop me... Watch out! It's an arrow! Cover yourself! Aaaaahhhhh!
Sir, I have to speak with you. I can be silent no more. Please, listen to me. I'd like to make a confession!
Who are you, knight? And what crimes do you want to confess to?
I'm sorry, knight, but I'm no priest. Go find one and he will gladly listen to your confession.
No, sir, I must tell it only to you. I know who you are and what you are searching for. I know all about the Children of the New Order!

Welcome to the coming realm of evil, dear son! I've been waiting for you. You are going to witness the birth of the New Order! You will see the destruction of the Divine Kingdom on Earth and of everything that has been built in its name. And we, the children of the New Order, will rule the enslaved world! The plan has just been completed! Welcome the Dark Prince and the Fallen Azrael!

Cardinal Commendoni, I came to arrest you for heresy and conspiracy against God and the King on the basis of reasonable suspicion. According to the results of the investigation you are a dark high priest of the Children of the New Order. You will go with me and stand a fair trial!

Don't be ridiculous, son! There's nothing you can do to stop the end of the world now—the succubus Cerdie, the ruler of promiscuity and of eternal sin has been summoned! That means that all the three Fallen Angels have been called upon this world to open the gates of the Dark Prince's prison—as the prophet Lucius, the founder of the Order, had foreseen!
I do not believe you! The Fallen Angels cannot be summoned into this world!

Really?! Are you sure about that? Then you must be really stupid, my son. The Fallen Angels have been summoned—exactly according to the plan. The prophet Lucius made a perfect plan. The whole world was thinking that the Children of the New Order were crushed and burned but they've been hiding for long centuries instead to strike at the other end of the faithful world—in Ultherst!
How? How did you manage to keep it hidden from the world for so long?

Very easily, my son. Lucius made four copies of the plan and gave each of them to a dark priest. Those priests didn't know each other and their sole mission was to guard the Plan during their lifetime and to find a successor to hand the plan over to him. So centuries passed and nobody was aware of what is going to happen. And when the time foretold in the Plan came, the last successors of the dark priests have met and jointly started to carry out the Plan!
If the Fallen Angels were really summoned, where are they now? How is it possible I do not see hell fires burning around and armies of hellspawns prancing about the Realm?!

Patience, my son. You will live to see, very soon. The Fallen Angels linger in their earthly kingdoms of ruin, madness and eternal sin and are preparing to jointly destroy the chains that have been binding the Dark Prince, our ruler for thousand years! And when it happens, all what people see in their nightmares will come true. It won't take long, my son!
I won't allow that!

Don't be ridiculous, son. What do you want to do? Stand against the Fallen Angels? There's nothing you can do against them—they are the highest infernal powers that have ever existed. It's the same as if you tried to destroy God. And you would have to enter their earthly kingdoms which you never will because you don't have the book Libre Daemonium. Only there you can find the description of the ritual that opens the gates of their earthly kingdoms...
In that case I will take the book from you, Cardinal!
No, you won't, son. Even if you managed to kill me. I do not have it here. It is securely hidden. Anyway, enough of this idle talk. I've lost too much time with you...
I agree. Cardinal Commendoni, I arrest you for heresy and conspiracy against God and the King on the basis if reasonable suspicion. You will go with me!
No, I won't. Just the contrary—you will stay and watch your world collapse. Providing that I won't make you my slave. But it is more likely I will just kill you. Let's see!

I most sincerely apologize for being so daring, but in the course of my investigation I heard a confession which says that—God forgive me—you are a dark high priest of a cult called the Children of the New Order. Could you please tell me what do you think about it?

You've alarmed me by that accusation, but I'm not surprised. I've been waiting for something like this for a long time. Without question this is an effort of heretics to blacken my name and inflict upon me the suspicion of heresy. There is nothing better for heretics than to discredit the Inquisition—their stubborn enemy. And I'm confident it's the work of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert! My son, you absolutely have to find out if it is really true!
Hmm... We shall see.
What prerequisites must I meet if I want to become a Curial Inquisitor?

You ponder over a curial seat, my son? In that case know that every judge of the Holy Office may become a Curial Inquisitor, if he passes an examination consisting of a practical part and of a theoretical part. Practical part means solving one factual case. Theoretical part is an oral examination which tests the aspirant's knowledge of canon law and of secular law. It is focused on jurisdiction and powers of the Holy Inquisition.
I'd like to become a Curial Inquisitor, Your Excellency. Would you be so kind to examine my knowledge?

As you wish, my son. I hope you are prepared sufficiently. I won't try to hide from you it is a very difficult task that I'm going to entrust you with. You will have to shed light on the murder of His Majesty King Edward II. If you manage to find his murderer and if you pass the theoretical part of the examination, I personally will appoint you as a Curial Inquisitor.
Alright, thank you.
You're welcome, my son. I myself wish you success—you will investigate a crime that must not remain unpunished. Regicide... that's unbelievable!
Are there any further details known about the death of His Majesty?

If my sources are correct, King Edward was found dead by his Chamberlain Trisstan in the evening several days ago. It seems there was a fight before the murder, since the furniture was overturned and scattered around. It stands to reason that the King resisted the assailant. That's all we were able to find.
To tell the truth, I've already found the murderer of His Majesty Edward II. May I present you with the results of my investigation, Your Excellency?
I've found the murderer of His Majesty Edward II. May I present you with the results of my investigation, Your Excellency?
I'd like to undertake the examination to become a Curial Inquisitor, Your Excellence.

You deem yourself ready? Optime, mi fili! Remember that knowledge of the law is absolutely crucial for a Curial Inquisitor. Without it you couldn't properly fulfill your holy mission and you would be a burden for the Holy Inquisition instead of an asset. Shall we start?
Yes, we shall start.
I'd like to repeat the examination to become a Curial Inquisitor, Your Excellency.

Alright. I trust you are better prepared than the last time. Do not forget that perfect knowledge of the law is absolutely crucial for a Curial Inquisitor to effectively perform his duties. So, let's start with the examination. Pararisne, mi fili?
Ita, Vestre Excellentissime Vire, paror.
What do you think about the crisis the Realm has been dragged into?
You speak about a crisis, my son, but I would not call it so. No, this is no crisis by all means...
Then what is it, Your Excellency?

It is an ordeal, my dear son. It is a trial that has been inflicted upon us because of our way of life. Or more precisely because of way of life of people which the Holy Mother Church should care about and look after. We have to admit to ourselves, my son, that we have been too benevolent and let laymen to do too many things that contravene God's laws. People should live with humility and modesty, not with pride and wealth. It's necessary for us to correct this mistake, because it leads to the heresy that we must nowadays fight. Excessive wealth breeds sin and we have to utterly eradicate it!
What do you think about Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert? Is he really a heretic?

Heresy of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert would explain much, my son. For example why has been the Grand Master putting so much effort into trying to suppress the jurisdiction of the Inquisition since the King signed Decretum Inquisitorium. And it is true that many of the citizens of Alvaron are convinced Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert really is a heretic. It's just another reason for common folk to fear what the future will bring them—where the heresy will end, after all, if it can taint even the head of a knightly order?!
Do you mean a storm during which demons would dance in the sky and you could hear lamentations of martyred souls as if the gates of the Hell were wide open?
Yes, exactly. How do you know that?

I was told such storms occurred this spring in Hillbrandt and in Glatzburg, and you've been to these towns lately, haven't you? But I may assure you, whatever these storms mean, none occurred here in Alvaron.

You want to know who are Arthamon, Baphomet, Cerdie and Azrael? Then know that they are the archenemies of God Almighty, the architects of evil, the tempters of nations and the rulers of the fallen souls. They are terrible tools of Satan in his hellish plans, his staunch vassals and executors of his evil will. Nobody and no one in this world may stand against them, because they are godlike beings, peerless and absolute.
What would happen if heretics managed to summon the Fallen Angels?
Then the end of this world would come, my son!
I'm searching for heretics here in Alvaron. Do you have any suspicions?
Frankly, my son, if I had any suspicion of heresy, I wouldn't wait for you and would immediately command to investigate it. But I appreciate your effort.
I hunt a heretical cult called the Children of the New Order. Have you heard about it?

Of course I know about the Children of the New Order. It was a cult gathered around certain Lucius in the tenth century. Lucius declared himself the Dark prophet and proclaimed the end of the world and coming of a perverted new order. Its children were supposed to rule the world alongside with Satan. The cult was dangerous in that it grew through all the layers of society and involved even the highest classes—both secular and clerical. Despite of that the Holy Office managed to uncover the heretics and execute them including Lucius in 1021. All that fortunately happened in the Empire, hundreds of miles away from the Realm. Thereby I'm very unnerved by notion the cult might have survived and even relocated itself here to Ultherst.

You ask me what happened in Alvaron lately? What else should I mention than the death of our beloved King Edward II by the hand of an unknown murderer right in the royal palace. How terrible loss for all the faithful world this is! What a disaster! What a tragedy for those hoping that he would lead us towards bright future!

It seems some heretics can use infernal powers to turn human ordure into gold for a short time. They then pay with those fake coins like they were genuine. You surely can imagine the mistrust and fears this raises among the people. Grand Duke Drake Lambert is very irritated by it and struggles to swiftly catch those foul criminals.
I need to obtain the testimony of a dead person. You wouldn't be able to give me some advice, would you?

Do you really want to get a dead person to confess to you? In that case I will give you an advice well meant—dismiss it immediately! You know well where such thinking leads—to heresy. It leads to deviation from all what is sacred and right. It will lead you to a stake. So be careful, my son, not to go astray when trying to administer good. You could end up on the wrong side...
I'm searching for a way to break the curse of a stryx. Could you give me some advice?

Stryx you say? Hmm... you are into very dangerous cases, son. I will give you one good suggestion—perform your holy duty and fight the evil with flame and sword, be it whatsoever. Stryx is a mighty spawn of evil, so do not try to reverse the work of darkness and kill the stryx instead. You surely will find out a way to do that...
I search for a way to cure a man of lycantrophy. Would you be able to help me?
I know a well-tried way to help a man stricken by lycantrophy—the God's grace. Kill the werewolf and God will see after his soul. Believe me, it will be the best way.
If you really want to know that, it will cost you $$moneypopTargetPop$$ gp.
Even your high rank won't shield you from God's anger if you deny me the answer to my question, Your Excellency!
Please, answer me, Your Excellency. I'm serious about it.
You are a wise and experienced man, Your Excellency. So I beg you not to deny me answers to my questions.
I came to you as to a member of the Supreme Tribunal, Your Excellency. I'd like to present to you evidence of heresy of a person which may be indicted only by this tribunal.

Really? In that case I have to call upon you to exercise the utmost caution, my son. Task of the Supreme Tribunal of Inquisition is to investigate heresy of high representatives of the society of the Realm. That means, that if you advance before the Tribunal with a suspicion of heresy, it concerns a person of high rank. And you have to gather all sorts of incriminating evidence to get even the consent to arrest them and bring a charge against them. Tell me then, whom does your suspicion concern?
It's more than mere suspicion, Your Excellency. And it concerns Christoffer de Malamert, the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous.

So you tell me you have the evidence of Grand Master Christoffer Malamert being guilty? Of him being a heretic? I won't hide from you I'm surprised by that. Grand Master de Malamert is one of the highest-ranking men in the Realm and despite his fierce dispute with the Holy Office he's greatly respected. May I ask you what evidence against the Grand Master do you have?

Petrier de Duby, a neophyte of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, confessed that Grand Master de Malamert attempts to disrupt the Realm with help of the powers of Hell whom he serves. Moreover we found two of Grand Master's letters in which he gives instructions to his minions how they should proceed in their joint plot to disrupt the Realm.

Really interesting... Frankly, my son, although at first sight your evidence seems to be credible and well speaking about the cruel atrocities the Grand Master is hiding before the world, the evidence also raises some doubts in me. I'll put aside the fact I count Grand Master de Malamert among my close friends, and will stick to the first part of your evidence. Neophyte Petrier de Duby of the Brotherhood of the Righteous apparently disappeared under hazy circumstances and he is still missing. It surprises me to learn about his part in the scheme just from you. Somebody could see a strange coincidence in it.
Your Excellency, I assure you that...

Do not interrupt me, my son. When I take into consideration the other two pieces of your evidence—the letters of Grand Master de Malamert addressed to other supposed heretics—and especially the fact the letters have been found thanks to the confession of Petrier de Duby, I see other incongruities. If I would be so daring to say the first evidence is faked, then it would mean neither of the second two pieces of evidence is true. It would mean you are lying to me and that you made it all up because of some wicked reason!
So, what are you going to do, Your Excellency?

What will I do? That's simple, my son. You want me to consent to the arrest of Grand Master de Malamert and to charge him with heresy. And I will give you my consent. Not that I trust your evidence—more to the contrary. I'm sure Grand Master de Malamert is innocent and your evidence is false. In this moment I do not want to say that you faked it—it is possible you are just an instrument in the hands of foul criminals. But now it is more important to relieve the Grand Master of the suspicion. And the only way to do that is that he stands before the Tribunal of the Inquisition. So go and try to get consent of at least two other members of the Tribunal. Only then you will be able to arrest the Grand Master and bring him to the Court.
Thank you, Your Excellency.
Save your thanks, son. I didn't do you a favor, more likely just the opposite.

So you've followed my advice and focused your investigation on Grand Master de Malamert? I'm really pleased. I'm sure he is the one we are searching for. But tell me, what evidence have you found against him?

Dreadful! I didn't expect such a direct evidence of heresy of Grand Master de Malamert. But it is good we managed to get it. I give you my consent to arrest the Grand Master, my son. The truth must be revealed!

Do not thank me, son. I didn't do you a favor, more likely just the opposite. You will bear the responsibility for the rightness of your investigation. If you are mistaken... But enough of such thinking. I believe you act correctly!
I'd like to ask you several questions, Your Excellency.
Ask away, then. I will try to tell you all you are interested in.
No, Your Excellency, I do not think so. Maybe later...
As you wish, son. You may of course seek me out anytime; I will be at hand every time you need. Farewell. I wish you luck.
Yes, I have some evidence. But I'm not sure if I should reveal it to you... It concerns you, Your Excellency!
Wha... what? You must be joking. Are you telling me there is any evidence casting a suspicion of a crime on me?
Just so.
That's wicked! What evidence do you have?

Amongst Cardinal Truncquillius's belongings I found letters in which he is instructed how to proceed with the realization of the Plan. And during the investigation here in Alvaron I found out that those letters were written by you. What will you tell me about it?
Really? Hmm... It's startling. And dreadful, too. Tell me, is there any other evidence against me?

Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, made confession before his death. He confessed he was member of the Children of the New Order and he named you as a dark high priest of the cult, Your Excellency.
Indeed? That's very interesting... The confession of seneschal Jean de Guise himself? Really startling. Do you have any other evidence against me, son?

When put to torture, royal counselor Verenicus confessed you are a dark high priest of the Children of the New Order. Together you performed an infernal ritual in the royal palace, at least he said that, and following that ritual Prince Louis was declared dead the next day!
Royal counselor Verenicus? Awful! I wouldn't expect that... But tell me, son, have you found any other evidence against me?
No, Your Excellency. That's all.

Hmm... You've really taken me unawares by what you've just told me. I haven't been expecting anything like that. It means I'm either a heretic or a victim of satanic intrigues. And because I really do not consider myself a heretic, it looks like intrigues of the Children of the New Order. There is nothing better for heretics than to discredit their stubborn enemy, the Inquisition. All that you told me is really very disgusting. And dangerous. You absolutely have to find out, my son, who fathered that entire plot against me. We will follow the track to the one who wanted to get rid of me this way. I will investigate this case myself! Frankly, I already have a suspicion...
Really? And whom it concerns, Your Excellency?

Christoffer de Malamert, the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. If I have correct information about the results of the present investigation, he might be connected to a certain conspiracy. It is critical to find out if it is he who is behind that false evidence against me!
Optime, mi fili! But now tell me, my son, if there is any way I can help you in your holy mission?

Hmm... You've quite alarmed me by what you've just told me, but not surprised. I've been expecting something like that. Without question this is an effort of heretics to blacken my name and inflict upon me a suspicion of heresy. There is nothing better for heretics than to discredit the Inquisition, their stubborn enemy. And I'm confident it's the work of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert! My son, you absolutely have to find out if it is really true! I've given you my consent with his arrest already, so now it's up to you!
Yes, I know.
Optime, mi fili. But now tell me, if there is any way I can help you in your holy mission?
But of course, my son! That is great news—murderers of His Majesty have been found! Tell me, who is the culprit? Who is to blame for the death of our monarch?
The murderer is First Knight Rodrigo de Velacor.

The First knight? I really didn't expect that. Why? The main mission of the First Knight is to defend the Crown and the Realm! How could he...? I'm shocked indeed. Apparently the devil is able to break into the thoughts of any man... Dreadful idea! But tell me, what evidence against him do you have?

Royal Chamberlain Trisstan witnessed the murder and has reliably identified the First knight. Then I got the testimony of Cardinal Gustaph Letti, whom the First Knight confessed to with his awful secret. And I found out the King wounded his murderer during their fight. The First Knight has scratches on his face—he refuses to speak about their origin. Under the weight of all this evidence Rodrigo de Velacor finally pleaded guilty of the crime.

Fascinating! You have managed to prove him guilty and compelled him to confess in an admirable way! You have fulfilled your task and you did it in a really great way! You've passed the practical part of the examination. But to become a Curial Inquisitor you have to pass the examination of your knowledge of canon and secular law. Are you ready for the test?
I'm ready, Excellency.

Then I will ask you several questions regarding both canon and secular law—you must answer them correctly. In case you fail to answer any of my questions, you'll have to retake the entire test another time.
Alright, Your Excellency, we may start.
Not yet, Your Excellency. I'd like to spend some more time studying.
That's a very wise decision, my son. Return, then, when you feel ready.
Quis summus Inquisitor Sancti officii nominari potest?
Omnis, qui dignus hoc officio est.
Tuum responsum mendosum est. I'm sorry, my son, but you are wrong. You have much to learn before you can be named a Curial Inquisitor. Go away and return when you are better prepared.
Supremi inquirentis iudicii iudex, quem archiepiscopus sanctae Matris Ecclesiae populi ultherici nominat.
Correct, my son! Excellent!
Lord be praised!
Omnis sacerdos, qui dignus hoc officio est.
Curialisne Inquisitor poena condonare potest condemnati, qui nocens ab inquirenti iudice inferiore quam illo Inquisitore curiale iudicatus est?
Non potest, Vestre Excellentissime Vire. Inquisitor curialis suo arbitrio exsecutioni iuris divinae intervenire non potest—sententia culpae firma est!
Potest. Omnes iudices in illa curia inferiores eo sunt.
Potest, sed solum voluntate iudicis, qui sententiam dixit.
Quam multos iudices summum una inquirens curia habere potest? Isne numerus quodam modo finitur?
Inquirens curia summum tredecim iudices habere potest—sicut tredecim vates fuerunt.
Inquirens curia infinitum inquirentium iudicum habere potest. Numerus quodam modo non finitur.
Inquirens curia summum tam multor iudices habere potest, quam multi necessari ad eam curiam sunt. Inquisitor curialis numerum statuit.
Homone supremi inquirentis iudicii alium hominem supremi inquirentis iudicii de haerese accusare potest?
Potest.
Non potest. Homo supremi inquirentis iudicii de haerese accusari potest solum ab ceteris hominibus officii nec modo ab uno eorum.
Potest, sed solum si satis argomentorum habet.
Summumne Inquisitorem ab suo officio amoveri licet?
Non licet. Officium summi Inquisitoris morte aut accusatione de haerese desinit.
Ceteri homines supremi inquirentis iudicii in tacitis suffragiis summum Inquisitorem amovere possunt!
Ex eo pendet utrum summus Inquisitor episcopus dioecesis necne sit.

Optime, mi fili! You have correctly answered all the questions about canon and secular law, and even in the ancient Lateran! I have no doubts about your qualities. So I'm greatly pleased to name you a Curial Inquisitor of the Holy Office. Take this item as the insignia of your new position. As a Curial Inquisitor of the Holy Office you can now ask judge Gregorius for one inquisitorial investigator to help you in your quest. Congratulations!
Thank you, Your Excellency. It's a great honor for me!

Welcome, my son. I heard you've arrived to the city. I'm glad to meet the man who was able to uncover decay in the ranks of the Holy Inquisition and without a trace of hesitation burned it with the flame of justice so it could not expand anymore. If you are curious who I am and how can I know so much about you, then know that I'm cardinal Commendoni, by the grace of God presently the Inquisitor General of the Holy Office. That explains much, doesn't it?
It's an honor to meet you, Your Excellency.

My pleasure, my son. I'm familiar with your case—from those unfortunate events in Hillbrandt to the investigation of cardinal Truncquillius, a Curial Inquisitor of Glatzburg. It is dreadful to think how prominent representatives of the Inquisition were ensnared in heresy, and they remained directly in the view of their unaware brothers Inquisitors. That proves one thing—Satan never sleeps and his wanton paws reach even there where eternal light of faithful champions of God should shine!
Yes, and well said.

But now tell me, my son, what brings you to Alvaron? I've read in your file that judge Vallarian and cardinal Truncquillius were condemned to be burned to death, which means both cases were successfully closed and the souls of the sinners were redeemed. So, what is the aim of your journey to Alvaron?
With your permission I'd like to keep the aim of my journey to myself. As you said—Satan never sleeps...

Oh... you really surprised me, son. There aren't many people who dare to sidestep answering the Inquisitor General's question. There is even a sort of an unwritten law that Inquisitor General's question is more like a command. But in this case you're probably right. One never knows what could happen. These times are too... hmm... unquiet to allow us to blindly trust all that is customary.
Sort of, Your Excellency. Thank you for understanding.

You are welcome, my son. I understand your reasons and applaud them. Welcome to Alvaron, the capital of the Realm. I hope your mission—no matter what it is—will be successful. But if you could spare some time, I'd like to point out to you certain allegation that has been brought lately...
Whom does this allegation concern?

Christoffer de Malamert, the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. If I have correct information about the results of the present investigation, he might be connected with certain conspiracy. It may be so that the circumstances that drove you to Alvaron concern Grand Master de Malamert somehow, and it's critical to find out!
Yes, that's very wise.
Optime, mi fili! We must not underestimate any trace we have, my son. But now tell me, how can I help you with your holy mission?
I found out that both sentenced prelates were members of a heretical cult called the Children of the New Order. And some traces I've found lead just here to the capital of the Realm.

This is alarming news, son. Very alarming. I'd thought the heretical acts of judge Vallarian and cardinal Truncquillius are not connected. It seemed to me that they were just independent results of them being led astray. But apparently I was wrong. Tell me more about it, my son. What evidence have led you here to Alvaron?
I'd like to keep the details of this case to myself if I may. I'll inform you when everything is properly investigated, Your Excellency.

Alright, as you wish, my son. I won't push you. And of course I will instruct my brothers Inquisitors to inquire into the matter of the Children of the New Order, because there are some suspicions that have to be investigated...
We must not underestimate any trace we have, my son. And you have a real suspicion. But now tell me, how can I help you with your holy mission?

There is a suspicion that the cult of the Children of the New Order tries to carry out its old Plan—its aim is nothing else than to summon the Fallen Angels and free Satan from his thousand-years old prison. And by all accounts the cult has managed to summon two of the Fallen Angels already—Arthamon and Baphomet.

My God, that's disgusting! I would not expect that even from the most hardened and perverse heretics. To toy with the thoughts of summoning the Fallen Angels and freeing Satan from his earthly prison is the utmost and deepest heresy I've met with. Your words have frightened me greatly, son. I will instruct my brothers Inquisitors to immediately start searching for the cult and its minions. We have to find out the truth about that plan of theirs. Tell me, do you have any particular evidence we should focus on?
No, I do not have any evidence. I found only vague clues suggesting that some members of the cult could linger in Alvaron.
I understand. In that case we will have to rely on informants and results of our own investigation. And frankly, we already have a suspicion...
When searching in the cardinal Truncquillius' belongings I found heretical letters, delivered to him from Alvaron. They instruct him how to proceed with the implementation of the cultist plan.

Letters, you say? That's indeed excellent! You have a direct evidence against the person who wrote those letters, son. You have to find out who their author is, at any cost. Try to focus on this evidence. Meanwhile, I will try to find other traces that would advance our investigation. To tell the truth, I already have certain suspicion...
I have no specific purpose of being here, Your Excellency. I just felt it is needed I visit Alvaron and find out if I may help here somehow.

That's noble of you, my son. I greatly appreciate your zeal for fighting heresy. We all should let ourselves be led by your example. I'm glad you will stay here. I believe your holy mission will soon take you in some specific direction. Frankly, you could investigate certain suspicion...

It concerns Christoffer de Malamert, the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. If I have correct information about the results of the present investigation, he might be connected with certain conspiracy. It's critical to find the truth about it. So, if you like you may focus on this suspicion.
Hmm... Thanks for the information. We shall see.
Optime. We must not underestimate any trace we have, my son. But now tell me, how can I help you with your holy mission?
Welcome, my son. What can the Inquisitor General do for you? What do you ask of him?
Ask away, then. I will try to give you satisfactory answers. After all, we both serve God...
Nothing for now, Your Excellency. I'm sorry for disturbing you.
No problem, son. I'm glad to see you are alive and well. Faithful people face constant mortal danger these hard days. Take care, right? And now, farewell.
Welcome, my son. How continues your search for the cult of the Children of the New Order?
I've made no progress yet, Your Excellency. I'm sorry.
No problem, my son. We all do what we can. Continue with your efforts and you will be awarded with the fruits of victory. What can I do for you now?
Ask away, then. I will try to answer all your questions. After all, we both serve God...
Welcome, my son. How is going your investigation of those false allegations against me? Have you found out if Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert is behind them?
Not yet, Your Ecellency.

In that case multiply your efforts, my son. Time is working against us and it may be that some other faked or spurious evidence will appear. I really wouldn't like that to happen. It's critical to find out and prove guilty the concoctor of those false proofs.
Certainly. May I speak with you for a while?
Sure, come closer and speak. I will try to answer your questions—if I will be able to.
I'll do my best, Your Excellency. Farewell for now.
God be with you, my son. And take care of yourself!
Not yet, Your Excellency. But there is another evidence against you...
Really?! That's shocking. Tell me what it is, please.

Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, made a confession before his death. He confessed he was member of the Children of the New Order and he named you as a dark high priest of the cult, Your Excellency.
That's all.
Apparently the intrigues of that cult reached monstrous proportions indeed! We must not wait, my dear son. We have to find out if Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert really is behind it.
Optime, mi fili. But now tell me, my son, if there is any way I can help you in your holy mission?

Apparently intrigues of that cult reached monstrous proportions indeed! We must not wait, my dear son. I'm positive it is the work of Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert! You absolutely have to find out if it is true. I've given you my consent with his arrest already, so now it's up to you!
A paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous steals?! It's unbelievable! No wonder this world is in such a bad state when even God's knights are thieves! Search your conscience, son!
You are wise and experienced man, Your Excellency. It's a dream of all men of God to listen to such celebrities like you are. So I beg you not to deny me answers to my questions.

So you tell me you have the evidence of Grand Master Christoffer Malamert being guilty? Of him being a heretic? I won't hide from you I'm surprised by it. Grand Master de Malamert is one of the highest-ranking men in the Realm. He is the head of a powerful knightly order, which notwithstanding its fierce dispute with the Holy Office is greatly respected. May I ask you what evidence against the Grand Master do you have?
No problem, son. I'm glad to see you are alive and well. Inquisitors face constant mortal danger these hard days. Take care, right? And now, farewell.

Welcome to the oncoming realm of evil, dear son. I've been awaiting you. You will witness the birth of the New Order! You will see the God's earthly realm falling down and all what has been created in its name crushed into dust. And we, the Children of the New Order, will rule the subdued world! The plan has reached completion! The Dark Prince and Fallen Angel Azrael be praised!

Cardinal Commendoni, I came to arrest you for heresy and conspiracy against God and the King on the basis of reasonable suspicion. According to the results of the investigation you are a dark high priest of the Children of the New Order. You will come with me and stand a fair trial!

Don't be ridiculous, my son. You can do nothing in this instant to avoid the end of the world. We have summoned succubus Cerdie, the wicked ruler of debauchery and eternal sin! That means all three Fallen Angels were summoned into this world to jointly open the gates of the earthly prison of the Dark Prince—just as it was foreseen by prophet Lucius, founder of the New Order!

Really? Are you sure about that? In that case you are very silly, my son. We've managed to do it! We did it right the way that was planned centuries ago. The Fallen Angels have been summoned! Prophet Lucius devised it perfectly! All the world have thought the Children of the New Order were crushed and burned to the last man, but instead the cult backed off into secrecy and waited for centuries to strike on the other end of the faithful world—in Ultherst!

Very easily, my son. Lucius made four copies of the plan and gave each of them to a dark priest. Those priests didn't know each other and their sole mission was to guard the plan during their lifetime and to find a successor to hand the plan over to him. So centuries passed and nobody was aware of what is going to happen. And when the time foretold in the plan came, the last successors of the dark priests have met and jointly started to carry out the plan!

Do not be ridiculous, son. What do you want to do? Stand up to the dark angels? You can do nothing to stop them. They are the highest beings of Hell ever. It is the same as if you tried to destroy God. Moreover you would have to break into their earthly kingdoms and you will never manage to do that, because you do not have the Libre Daemonium book. For only there you may learn the ritual to open the gates of infernal realms...
The Inquisitor of the Holy Office steals?! I can't believe it! It's no wonder this world is in so bad state when even priests are thieves! Scrutinize your conscience, son!

The First Knight? I really didn't expect that. Why? The main mission of the First Knight is to defend the Crown and the Realm! How could he...? I'm shocked indeed. Apparently the devil is able to break into the thoughts of any man... Dreadful idea! But tell me, what evidence against him do you have?

Royal Chamberlain Trisstan witnessed the murder and has reliably identified the First Knight. Then I got the testimony of Cardinal Gustaph Letti, whom the First confessed to with his awful secret. And I found out the King wounded his murderer during their fight. The First Knight has scratches on his face—he refuses to speak about their origin. Under the weight of all this evidence Rodrigo de Velacor finally pleaded guilty of the crime.
A noble man steals?! It's unbelievable! No wonder this world is in such a bad state when even the gentry are thieves! Search your conscience, son!
Why doesn't anybody do anything with all those werewolves raging around Alvaron?!
I really have no idea...
My god! What shall we do?! We cannot get out of the city...
I'm sure somebody will do something about it soon!
Really? That means my prayers were answered. Why, we cannot get out of the city...
Don't be afraid, the Brotherhood of the Righteous will take care of that!
Really? In that case, my prayers would be answered...
Hmm... the Brotherhood of the Righteous is surely omnipotent, but can it really cope with all those packs of werewolves? But maybe you are right...
I fear I would be killed by werewolves if I leave the town. There are dozens of them behind every tree!
It will change soon, don't lose your faith!
Really? That means my prayers were answered...
Hmm... I'd like to know how you want to achieve that. But I believe you.
Yes, I'm afraid that's true...
My goodness! What will we do? Surely we cannot live here like prisoners...
It's told that you killed wolf-prince Wulfhyrr all by yourself, knight. Is it true?
Indeed, it is true!
Heavens! So it's true the Almighty has answered our prayers and sent us our savior! God bless you, knight!
No, I don't know anything about it.

Do not be too modest, knight. People everywhere speak about you killing that hellspawn in a fierce fight. It's sure Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of werewolves. God bless you, knight!
I wish these hard times were behind us already...
Yes, you are right...
They will be soon, do not lose your faith!

How very hard these days are, knight! Who would think we would one day awake to see the Star of Doom blaze like a sinister eye in the sky? And that we would be struck by all those God's punishments that priests have been horrifying us by in their sermons. It's terrible...
Do not lose your faith, we still have hope of salvation.

It's easy for you to say that, knight. You are a paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous and God favors you. But who will guarantee the common people that God will accept them into his herd again? Nobody...
Yes, you are probably true. I will pray for you...
Yes, it is really terrible... Goodbye.
My God, why have you abandoned us? Why have you done this to us? Are our sins so grave? Have we been so bad? Oh my God, why have you abandoned us...
You have to stop it, knight! You have to stop it once and for all!
What do you mean? What should I stop?

The evil, knight! The evil in human souls. It spreads like some fatal disease; we may be infected at any moment. Haven't you noticed how few people attend services in churches? People think there is no point in going into a church. And many of them are being diverted to idols, old pagan gods or even to the Prince of Darkness himself!
I'll do what I can...
I hope you do, knight. Because otherwise we will have no hope left...
Have no fear, the evil will be utterly destroyed!
Consider it done!
People think the end of the world is drawing near. Is it true, knight?
No, it is not true, you may be sure.
That's good... Thank you!
I wish it would be so. I will pray for it!
Well... but it definitely seems so...
It's possible. But nobody knows for sure.
My God... what shall we do?!
Oh my God, why have you condemned us?! Have we sinned so much? Oh my God!...
If you were a common man like me, knight, what would you do in these hard days?
I would pray to God. God is our salvation!
Hmm... Maybe you are right. Thank you!
Prayers haven't been good for anything so far. Certainly they didn't stop any of the Scourges.
I would shut myself at home and hope things will turn to good soon!
Really? Well... it seems worth thinking about. Thank you, knight.
I would sell all my belongings and then donate all the money to the Brotherhood of the Righteous so that it could better administer justice in the Realm.
Really?! Hmm... I will think about it.
I need you to come with me, good man.
Me? Why me?! I didn't do anything...
Don't be afraid, I mean you no harm. I just need your help. You may trust me...
Alright then... let's go. But I hope to be back as soon as possible...
Good bye...
Don't be afraid, the Inquisition will take care of that!
Hmm... the Inquisition surely is omnipotent, but can it really cope with all those packs of werewolves? But maybe you are right...
It's told that you killed wolf-prince Wulfhyrr all by yourself, Father. Is it true?
Heavens! So it's true the Almighty has answered our prayers and sent us our savior! God bless you, Father!

Do not be too modest, Father. People everywhere speak about you killing that hellspawn in a fierce fight. It's sure Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of werewolves. God bless you, Father!

How very hard these days are, Father! Who would think we would one day awake to see the Star of Doom blaze like a sinister eye in the sky? And that we would be struck by all those God's punishments that priests have been horrifying us by in their sermons. It's terrible...

It's easy for you to say that, Father. You are a priest and closer to God than anybody else. But who will pray for common men? Who will guarantee them God will again accept them into his herd? Nobody...
You have to stop it, Father! You have to stop it once and for all!

The evil, Father! The evil in human souls. It spreads like some fatal disease; we may be infected at any moment. Haven't you noticed how few people attend services in churches? People think there is no point in going into a church. And many of them are being diverted to idols, old pagan gods or even to the Prince of Darkness himself!
I hope you do, Father. Because otherwise we will have no hope left...
People think the end of the world is drawing near. Is it true, Father?
If you were a common man like me, Father, what would you do in these hard days?
Really? Well... it seems worth thinking about. Thank you, Father.
I would sell all my belongings and then donate all the money to the Church.
The Inquisitor of the Holy Office steals?! It's unbelievable! No wonder this world is in such a bad state when even priests are thieves! Shame!
Don't be afraid, your Grand Duke will take care of that!
Hmm... Grand Duke Lambert is surely omnipotent, but can he really cope with all those packs of werewolves? Even the Brotherhood of the Righteous isn't able to do that. But maybe you are right...
It's told that you killed wolf-prince Wulfhyrr all by yourself, noble lord. Is it true?
Heavens! So it's true the Almighty has answered our prayers and sent us our savior! God bless you, noble lord!

Do not be too modest, noble lord. People everywhere speak about you killing that hellspawn in a fierce fight. It's sure Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of werewolves. God bless you, noble lord!

How very hard these days are, noble lord! Who would think we would one day awake to see the Star of Doom blaze like a sinister eye in the sky? And that we would be struck by all those God's punishments that priests have been horrifying us by in their sermons. It's terrible...
It's easy for you to say that, noble lord. You are a noble and God favors you. But who will guarantee the common people that God will accept them into his herd again?? Nobody...
Yes, you're right. I'll ask a priest to serve a mass for you...
You have to stop it, noble lord! You have to stop it once and for all!

The evil, noble lord! The evil in human souls. It spreads like some fatal disease; we may be infected at any moment. Haven't you noticed how few people attend services in churches? People think there is no point in going into a church. And many of them are being diverted to idols, old pagan gods or even to the Prince of Darkness himself!
I hope you do, noble lord. Because otherwise we will have no hope left...
People think the end of the world is drawing near. Is it true, noble lord?
If you were a common man like me, noble lord, what would you do in these hard days?
Really? Well... it seems worth thinking about. Thank you, noble lord.
I would sell all my belongings and then donate the proceeds to the gentry so that they could use them to improve the situation of the Realm.
Why doesn't anybody do anything with all those thieves and brigands raging around Glatzburg?!
I'm sure somebody will do something about it!
Don't be afraid, the Brotherhood of the Righteous will take care of that soon!
Really? In that case my prayers were answered...
Hmm... the Brotherhood of the Righteous is surely omnipotent, but can it really cope with all those files of brigands? But maybe you are right...
I fear to leave the town, because if I do, brigands would fall on me and kill me... There are dozens of them behind every tree!
Hmm... I'd like to know how do you want to achieve that. But I believe you.
It's told that you single-handedly killed Benthley of Welshrem, the Bloody Butcher. Is it true?

Do not be too modest, knight. People everywhere speak about you bringing Benthley's head to Grand Duke Heidrick. Surely the Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of that brigand. God bless you, knight!
A paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous steals?! I can't believe it! No wonder this world is in such a bad state when even God's knights are thieves! Shame!
Hmm... the Inquisition surely is omnipotent, but can it really cope with all those files of brigands? But maybe you are right...

Do not be too modest, Father. People everywhere speak about you bringing Benthley's head to Grand Duke Heidrick. Surely the Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of that brigand. God bless you, Father!
Don't be afraid, your Grand Duke will take care of that soon!
Hmm... Grand Duke Heidrick is surely omnipotent, but can he really cope with all those files of brigands? But maybe you are right...

Do not be too modest, noble lord. People everywhere speak about you bringing Benthley's head to Grand Duke Heidrick. Surely the Almighty has sent you to save us from the bloody rage of that brigand. God bless you, noble lord!
Why they do not send us reinforcements from Glatzburg? We have so small army here that we would not be able to resist if the hellspawns would attack us all at once...
I really do not know, sorry.
Oh my God, what shall we do?!
I'm sure some reinforcements will arrive soon!
We do not need any reinforcements—your Duke will take care of everything!
Really? That is great news. My prayers were answered...

Hmm... Duke Weinberg is surely omnipotent as concerns people, but he alone cannot take care of the hellspawns. Their numbers are greater than the stars in the sky! My God, what on earth shall we do when they attack us?!
I'm afraid we won't survive the next attack of the orcs. Those green beasts are just too numerous...
Don't lose your faith—we have hope till we breathe!
Yes, that's true. Thank you, knight. In these days each word of comfort is precious...
Yes, it may be true. But question is how long we will breathe...
They say you single-handedly killed the orcish Khan Rashgar. Is it true, knight?
In that case it's sure the Almighty has sent you to help us in our suffering! God bless you, knight!
Don't be so modest, knight. People everywhere speak about you bringing Rashgar's head to Duke Weinberg. You are a real hero! Surely the Almighty has sent you to save us. God bless you, knight!

How very hard these days are, knight! Who would think we would one day awake to see the Star of Doom blaze like a sinister eye in the sky? And that we would be struck by all those God's punishments that priests have been horrifying us with in their sermons. It's terrible...

It's easy for you to say that, knight. You are a paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous and God favors you. But who will pray for the common people? Who will guarantee them that God will accept them into his herd again? Nobody...
Yes, you are probably right. I will pray for you...
We have to stop it, noble lord! We have to stop it once and for all!
Prayers haven't been good for anything so far. Certainly they didn't stop any of the Scourges. Well then...
I would donate all my belongings to the Brotherhood of the Righteous so that it could better administer justice in the Realm.
We do not need any reinforcements—the Inquisition will take care of everything!

Hmm... The Inquisition surely is omnipotent as far as people are concerned, but it alone cannot take care of the hellspawns. Their numbers are greater than the stars in the sky! My God, what on earth shall we do when they attack us?!
Yes, that's true. Thank you, Father. In these days each word of comfort is precious...
They say you single-handedly killed the orcish Khan Rashgar. Is it true, Father?
In that case it's sure the Almighty has sent you to help us in our suffering! God bless you, Father!
Don't be so modest, Father. People everywhere speak about you bringing Rashgar's head to Duke Weinberg. You are a real hero! Surely the Almighty has sent you to save us. God bless you, Father!

How very hard these days are, Father! Who would think we would one day awake to see the Star of Doom blaze like a sinister eye in the sky? And that we would be struck by all those God's punishments that priests have been horrifying us with in their sermons. It's terrible...
I would donate all my belongings to the Church.
You do not need any reinforcements, your Duke will take care of everything!

Hmm... Duke Weinberg surely is omnipotent as concerns people, but he alone cannot take care of the hellspawns. Their numbers are greater than the stars in the sky! My God, what on earth shall we do when they attack us?!
Yes, that's true. Thank you, noble lord. In these days each word of comfort is precious...
They say you single-handedly killed the orcish Khan Rashgar. Is it true, noble lord?
In that case it's sure the Almighty has sent you to help us in our suffering! God bless you, noble lord!
