Why such restrictions?
You refuse my love?! Then I'll have to make love to your corpse!
Come closer, my lovely son. You're so beautiful... Let's make love!
Yuk! I'm not a sodomite!
I can't... I swore the oath of purity.
Come closer, my lovely brother. You're so beautiful... Let's make love!
Thank you, but I prefer women.
Don't you dare to touch me, you madman!
There have been so many of those who said that...
I don't think I'd make a good corpse donor. I'd better be going...
You're not going anywhere, son. At least not alive...

Let's see who comes to visit us! A lost mortal it seems. What are you doing here, son?! Have you come to admire my work? Just look around—all those undead you can see were brought back to this world by their new father!
You summon undead?! But it's a mortal sin!
Yes, my opinion is exactly the same. One can say we live in sin... Well, enough talking—I have my mission. There's no time to waste. Looking at you, I'm sure you'll make an excellent corpse!
Congratulations. It's an admirable achievement...

Do you really think so?! I'd say that it's not that good yet. I'd need more corpses... Well, looking at you, son, I think that you might be able to help me with that. I'm sure you'll make an excellent corpse!

Salve, mi dilecte frater. Felicem exitus tui sancti muneris a deo precor. Hoc gravius quam munus omnium ceterorum esse scio...
Meum munus tam grave quam tuum est, frater. Ambo deo servimus, sed unus aliter ac alter.
Tibi, frater, gratias ago. Vale.
Ehm... sure, whatever. Farewell.
Greetings, son. I'm praying for the salvation of your soul. May all the saints bless God's knights!
Yes, that would be surely helpful...
Greetings, son. Can I ask you if it's difficult to be a paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous? What do you do in the course of fulfilling your mission?

It's rather dirty work, Father. I have to fight hellspawns every day, kill villains and idolaters, wade in blood up to my armpits... Believe me, nothing will take away your appetite as completely as seeing someone's entrails falling on the ground.
Gulp... ehm... thank you, son. I hope you'll stay in God's favor for a long time. I'll pray for the salvation of your soul...
It's noble work, Father. Contemplation intertwines the fight against minions of Hell for God's greater glory!

I can feel the terrible burden of your mission upon your shoulders—it almost drops to your knees. I must admire you, son. I wouldn't be able stand face to face with heretics and hellspawns... God bless you.
I'm glad you've come to boost the number of the local faithful, son! God bless you!
Whoever dispraises the Brotherhood of the Righteous is committing the worst sin possible—why, the Brotherhood is the hedge between chaos and order!
Yes, exactly!
Thank you, Father. Nevertheless everybody is allowed to his opinion—if it's not against God or against laws!

I need some healing.
Then come closer, son, and let divine mercy heal your wounds...
Then I should bid you godspeed, son. We must focus on our holy mission...
Thank you, Father. Could I repay you your kindness somehow?

It's not necessary, son. We're just performing His will... Well, but when I'm thinking about it, your help could be useful, after all. Since the moment we were sent here we've been looking for the foundation stone of the original temple of the First Prophet which was supposed to be built somewhere near after Galibornium was conquered by the faithful armies. Contemporary chronicles testify that the foundation stone was consecrated by Saint Orthenius himself. Unfortunately, we haven't been able to find it yet and we're afraid that it might have gone missing during all those centuries. Could you help us find its location?
Very well, I will help you to find the stone.
Excellent, son! You're a real altruist. May the Archangel Gabriel spread his protective wings over you!
And what about a reward?
You mean divine favor, right? Yes, I'm sure that if you find the stone you'll be granted exceptional divine favor!
I'm sorry, but archeology does not seem to be a part of my holy mission.
I see... Then it seems you can't help us. Farewell, son.
Greetings, son. I'm burning with impatience—do you bring the foundation stone you've promised us to retrieve?
Not yet, Father. You must be patient.
Oh, of course, you're right. I'm sorry for insisting that much. What can we do for you then?
Yes, I have the stone for you. Here you go.

It must really be the stone! Heavens... we have received the foundation stone of the temple of the First Prophet consecrated by Saint Orthenius himself! It's one of the most wonderful discoveries in the history of diocese. Entire faithful community is grateful to you, son!
You're welcome... it was really nothing...
Your modesty does you credit, son. Thanks you once again for that wonderful discovery. Anyway, could you please tell us how we may be of service?
Greetings, son. What can we do for you?
It's your lucky day, Father. I've already found the stone—here it is.

Books in this part of library seem really ancient. It's quite likely that they date back to the times most ancient—to the times when the Realm was founded.
Yes, I was right. There are mostly ecclesiastical texts written in the years following the year 223 of the New Era.

Oh, and this must be the famous Killian's chronicle—the oldest chronicle in the Realm—many thought it was irretrievably lost a long time ago! There's a description of the death of Saint Orthenius himself!

Hmmm, there are many interesting issues. For instance that Saint Orthenius was laid to rest in his tomb not far from the place where he gloriously defeated the Erebornian armies in 223 and that the entrance to the tomb was sealed by three magic statuettes of angels Raphael, Michael and Gabriel which were then taken away by priests of the order of Saint Orthenius to be hidden at secret places. Hmm... indeed interesting!
Ask around, knight—I'm sure you'll soon find out where to buy what you need...
I've heard some rumors about a coming war. Do you know any details about it?
Yes, I've heard something about a war, that's true... But because I'm not going to get myself recruited, I don't pay much attention to it.
I think it's better for me not to think anything about Christoffer de Malamert, because I don't have any idea on whose side you stand.
That's wise.
I think so too. You can't be careful enough nowadays.
I don't stand on any side. I'm a servant of God.
Well, that's it...
Considering the fact that I do my best to avoid monsters I'm not the best person to take lectures from. But it's true that the city and its surroundings are crawling with hellspawns...

If my memory serves me well, Grand Duke Drake Lambert offered big rewards for hunting down werewolves who pester not only the woods around the city but the city streets as well. The reward will be paid by Sheriff Henry Portmann for every trophy—that means for every werewolf head.

I would hate to disturb the dead, as one would say, but I've heard that some people still suspect royal counselor Verenicus of participating in the murder of Prince Louis. I know that two palace servant girls, Corin Morray and Kathryn Winhold, were sentenced for it, but the word is that Kathryn Winhold was the first to accuse Verenicus of his participation in the murder. Nevertheless she took it back when arrested and tortured. I'll tell you one thing, knight, there's nothing easier than putting somebody to torture and getting any testimony you'd like out of him. No offense, of course...

Can I take a look at the arrow? Hmmm... interesting craftsmanship. Nevertheless I can't help you much—I've never seen such an arrow. By the way... whose blood is it on that arrow? Oh... a stupid question... sorry.

So you're trying to figure out how the werewolves get into the city every full moon, right? Hmmm... I'm sorry, but I don't know anything that could help you. I'm really sorry. Maybe you could try asking the guards who were supposed to be on duty the night the werewolves came if they didn't see anything suspicious—before they were put to sleep, of course...

Yes, I've heard about the rape of Grand Duchess Liana Lambert by Father Nicolas, still I have no idea what that accusation proves or disproves. I've heard that Grand Duchess Liana Lambert is rather flighty and that she would be willing to do anything no matter how dirty if it could satisfy her bodily lust. That's why I'm wondering how can be someone like that raped... But I guess it doesn't matter. What matters is the fact that Father Nicolas has no evidence against that accusation—I can't help you with that either, because I don't know much about it...

There's a rumor that a terrible stryx lives at the city cemetery. According to legends she was born a certain cursed girl named Joan. It seems that she was cursed by her own mother, a nun of the Order of Saint Bethesda, who had been raped by a goatish priest. She had lost her mind after the rape and she had been aimlessly wandering throughout the Realm until the day when she gave birth to her daughter at the Alvaron cemetery.

Immediately after giving birth to the child she cursed her and then committed suicide. They found the girl in the morning—there were no signs of life so they buried her in an unmarked grave. Years went by and no one suspected the curse was slowly changing Joan into a dreadful stryx that would try to take life of her sinful father who was after all the cause of the tragedy. And that's exactly what happened—the stryx awoke and since then she has been stalking the city to make a snack of her papa. It's said she will kill anyone she meets...
I recommend you answer my question, good man. You don't want to oppose me, do you?!
It seems you don't like me for some reason, good man. Regardless I beseech you to answer my question.
I would really love to hear your answer, good man. You're renowned for your wisdom and experience far and wide.
Sven Larsen, I hereby arrest you on suspicion of the premeditated murder of paladin Eradim d'Chambrie. You are coming with me to face a fair trial!
I'm sorry, knight, but it must be some mistake... I'm no murderer. I'm just an honest merchant!
Your guilt or innocence will be determined by the court. Let's go!

I'm sorry, knight, but I'm not going anywhere with you. Yes, I am aware of the fact that it is a crime, but I cannot act differently. I know very well that when tortured I'd admit to crimes I've never committed. Although to be honest I can't imagine too many of them...
So you plead guilty!

Call it whatever you wish, knight. Anyway, if I can advise you, better defend yourself as your life's at stake! I don't have anything against you—it's nothing personal. I just think that it'll be better if I kill you than to let you flay the skin off my back and to let you pierce my flesh with red-hot nails. Now—defend yourself!
I doubt that. I found irrefutable proof convicting you of the murder!

Really? Hmmm... I'd say that changes our situation rather significantly. I will have to kill you, knight. I'm a bit sorry about it, because I've never liked killing paladins of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, but I will have to make an exception in your case. Solely for self-preservation reasons, I hope you understand! I couldn't have anticipated that you'd be able to expose me!
Call it whatever you wish, knight. Anyway, if I can advise you, better defend yourself as your life's at stake!

Hello, knight. We have a very nice day today, don't you think? I'd have even dared to say that it is exquisite, were it not for those other unfortunate circumstances preventing me from stating that...
Can I know your name, good man?
By all means. My name is Larsen. Sven Larsen. Well, friends call me Lars. Nevertheless, there are not many people I could consider to be friends, thus I can't enjoy the nickname too often.
How come you don't have many friends? You seem to be a good mannered and well educated man.

Yes, I could agree with that. Although the background of my parents was rather low I was allowed to study at the University of Primias and to achieve a bachelor's degree there. Despite that people rather tend to avoid me. Perhaps it's that occupation of mine.
And what's your occupation?

You could say that I'm a dealer. Yes, that seems most fitting. Dealing is all my life and friends must be sometimes also dealt with, and as I'm an adamant dealer I just don't have many friends. Business is more important than friendship.
Yes, some people think that. Well, I hope it's not that bad... Anyway, could I ask you some questions now?
Asking me questions? Well, that reminds me of Truth or Dare... I'm sorry it was just an inappropriate association... Of course you can ask anything you want, knight. I'll be glad to help you.
What do you deal in? Could I buy something from you?

I'm sorry but I don't have a retail store here; moreover I'm sure my goods wouldn't be very attractive to you. I deal neither in weapons, armor, alchemical products nor in magic accouterments. I deal in raw material.
I understand. Then I'd be glad if you could answer some of my questions.
Interesting. But I will have to leave now - duty calls. It was a pleasure for me to meet you.
For me as well, knight. I'm sure we'll have an opportunity to have a little talk in the future. Good day.
Maybe. I can't asses that as I'm not a merchant.

Of course... you're a paladin. But even your profession cannot disguise certain business features. Let's say the fees paid by brothers, management of castles and fortresses, selling of crops... there are many activities that draw the Brotherhood of the Righteous close to business issues. Especially nowadays...
Yes, you're right. But who coud object to that?
Certainly, knight. You'll see pretty soon that money is going to be more important than honor and justice, and all who won't go with the times will die. It's just a matter of time, you'll see.
I hope you're wrong. Anyway, could I ask you some questions now?
I hope so. Could you excuse me now, good man? I'll have to go. It was a pleasure meeting you.
Was it supposed to be an animadversion of the Brotherhood of the Righteous?!

I don't know. Maybe. The truth is that there are many opinions like that in the Realm. You can hardly object to that, knight. Who can say that the change, whatever it might be, won't be the Will of God?
You're obviously quite good at theology and rhetoric, good man, but what about answering my questions?
Hmm... I'd better be going.

I'll have to take my leave. It was a pleasure meeting you.
You can choose neither your wife nor your friends as goes one rather sarcastic saying...
Yes, I could agree with that, knight. A very apt comment. Nevertheless, can you tell me what brings you to me? I suppose that friendship has nothing to do with that...
Well, in fact I don't need anything.

I'm talking about the open political crisis into which the Realm has been dragged and also about those unfortunate events that befell Ultherst during the last three years.. Black Death, famine, rain of fire, heretic movements, monsters lurking in each and every shadow...
Greetings, knight. I knew we would have an opportunity to have a little talk in the future. What brings you to me?
I would like to ask you some questions.

How could you know that we would be talking again? There was a good chance we might never have met each other again...
That was quite unlikely... I immediately knew that we would meet again—at least once.

Enough! The pain... By all devils, enough, knight! I've never experienced so much pain in my life... I have a feeling I'm at Death's door. Blood tastes so strange, don't you think, knight? I think that if I surrender now I'll experience all the pleasures of the torture chamber, am I right?
Surrender now and you'll face a just trial!

Justice is God. Surrender yourself into His hands and you'll be forgiven...

If I surrender there will surely be torture and interrogation, right? Very well... I've been always fascinated by the idea I could end up in the embrace of those torturing instruments. Ask around, Father—I'm sure you'll soon find out where to buy what you need...

So you have finally arrived, my son. Come closer, I've been waiting for you...
Enough! What madness is that? What is going on here?!

What is going on here?! What is going on here?! What a stupid question, my son. I was sure you managed to reveal and expose everything. So why the hell are you asking me what's going on? Isn't it obvious? Oh, I see it isn't... Then let's have a little lesson, shall we? Just to allow your soul to rest in peace. So, the Fallen Angels were summoned, right? And the Plan of the Cult mentioned that the Dark Lord would be released from his prison then. Long story short—as the Dark High Priest of the Cult I'm just working on it!
Wait a minute, the Dark High Priest of the Cult of the Children of the New Order was Cardinal Commendoni, wasn't he?

Really? No, my dear son, I must disappoint you—Cardinal Commendoni was just one of the Dark Priests; although he was my closest ally and the executor of my will. I ordered him to act as the Dark High Priest on my behalf—you know, I didn't want any unwanted attention. Cleverly crafted, wasn't it? Not very original, but still clever. I really do admire him for playing his role till the very end. It's obvious he was completely devoted to the Plan. Moreover it provided me with enough time to prepare everything.
To prepare what? A ritual to summon Satan?

Well, finally you seem to have started to think. Yes, it is exactly as you've said—it was the objective of the Plan to summon Satan, the Dark Prince of Hell, through the summoning of the Fallen Angels—through the opening of the Gates of Chaos, Despair and of Fornication...
I'm sorry to bring you bad news, Your Holiness, but all the Fallen Angels were destroyed. I sent them back to burning Hells. Your Plan failed!

Don't be ridiculous, son. Haven't you understood the true objective of the Plan? Haven't you discovered its hidden meaning? Do you really think that Satan would be released by summoning of Arthamon, Baphomet and Cerdie into our world? Are you really convinced that their physical projection into our world means anything at all? No, my son, you're mistaken. That doesn't matter at all!
I don't know what you're talking about! The plan stated that the summoning of the Fallen Angels would cause Satan to be released from his prison, didn't it?!

Yes, but it was just a metaphor! I'm sure that you're well aware of the fact that the Fallen Angels are the embodiment of three terrible infernal forces—of Despair, Chaos and of Fornication. It's so to allow people to better comprehend their nature. They must be shown something physical to believe that it's dangerous for them. They must believe that somewhere deep in Hell is a hideous being with countless teeth and claws to be afraid of it and to live humbly. That was the concept of your Church—and I must say that it was rather clever. Nevertheless in the end it caused that people couldn't comprehend the meaning and focused only at the form. And as you have been probably already taught in your life, form is tricky!
What does it mean?!

Son, you're a hopeless case it seems. You've been investigating the greatest case of heresy and conspiracy in the history of the Realm and now when you discover the main culprit you have no idea what it was all about. Anyway, I'm going to explain it to you because I want to ask you a single question which you wouldn't be able to answer without comprehending everything. Very well—the summoning of the Fallen Angels mentioned in the Plan of the Dark Prophet Lucius was not intended to bring their physical projection into our world but rather to invoke the infernal powers they represent. That means Satan will be summoned regardless of the physical presence of Arthamon, Baphomet or Cerdie in our world—the only thing that matters are their infernal powers. And those have been irrecoverably unleashed! Just look around and tell me, do your really think that there's still the Kingdom of God on Earth as described by the Holy Scriptures? I don't think so—just the contrary. I can see only mortal sins—one alongside another. People are killing each other, they're given to fits of rage and are fornicating with each other regardless of law or order. That's what I call Hell!
Why then was the Cult trying so hard to summon the physical projections of the Fallen Angels?!

Because we needed to take the attention of the people away from the true objective of the Plan. That's why I summoned all the Dark Priests earlier this year to start a big show after several hundreds years of waiting. In fact it was not really necessary as its objective was just to attract the attention of all the defenders of the Realm and of divine order. As you can see it worked out without a hitch.
What then is the real objective of the Plan? And why do you need the body of Prince Louis?!

Well, finally we're getting to the point. As you correctly found out, Prince Louis did not die, he was put into the state close to death. That was done because we needed to prepare him for the ritual I'm going to perform in a moment. And that's the real objective of the Plan—to embody Satan into the body of Prince Louis! Surely you didn't think that releasing Satan from his prison meant that a giant horned demon would be walking the world trampling one kingdom after another with his blazing hooves—It'd be an utter nonsense! No, my son, Satan can lead the nations of the world astray only through man, as man is the instigator of all evil. There would be no Hell without man!
That's abhorrent!

No, my son—that's brilliant! You'll see for yourself real soon. As you can see, the Dark Prophet Lucius planned and prepared everything to the tiniest detail—of course with the assistance from the Fallen Archangel Azrael. All that needed to be done was to wait for the right moment. The Holy Scripture, the Revelation of Saint Ezekiel—to be more specific, says that Satan will be released from his prison after a thousand years. Of course it's a nonsense which was introduced by Ezekiel's imagination, or better to say by delirium tremens caused by unrestrained drinking. Nevertheless, common people were influenced greatly. As soon as the year 1223 started to loom, people began to be scared of the end of the world, because they believed that the beginning of the God's Kingdom on Earth dated back to 223 when the pagan Empire of Ereborn fell and faithful kingdoms were born. Of course that's nonsense as well. Well, but it was an opportunity we could not just let go!
But what about the Scourges of God?! According to the Scriptures they were meant to herald the end of the world!

Yes, that's right. Nevertheless it's again just nonsense invented by that old fool Ezekiel. Nevertheless it came in handy. I knew that the Star of Doom would appear above Ultherst in 1219—in fact it is a comet returning to our world every thousand years. As you can see, I'm not a rigid supporter of the idea that the world is flat and that it's floating in the middle of the space as states the Church doctrine. The fact that I opened my mind to new scientific discoveries allowed me to prepare everything necessary. You can't imagine how easy it was, with my new knowledge, to cause bad crops, plague and even the rain of fire—it was just a clever combination of magic and of alchemy. Master Theil Brechthold, the former royal alchemist, helped me greatly with all that—I believe you could have met him in Hillbrandt. He's a great scientist!
My God... it was all set up then!

Exactly, my son. As you can see, even Evil must be helped lest we want it to remain only in the lines of poems and novels. Nevertheless it worked unbelievably well—the people were persuaded that the end of the world is nigh and by their foolish, unrestrained behavior they themselves introduced the infernal powers of despair, chaos and fornication into the world. That was the moment Satan had been waiting for. Now he can enter this world as it's ready for his rule. Now he's going to be born in Prince Louis to sit on the Ultherst throne, from which he shall lead all the nations of the world astray!
If somebody doesn't stop you...

Exactly, my son. Nevertheless, considering the fact that you're the only one here and the ritual is almost finished, it'd have to be you. And that brings me to the question I wanted to ask you. You performed really well in your investigation and you achieved admirable results. It certainly required great courage to face Judge Vallarian and Cardinal Truncquillius, let alone your deeds when investigating Cardinal Commendoni. It'd be to the detriment of our cause to lose you, as our work is just about to begin today. It won't be easy to disrupt all the faithful kingdoms and to lead all the nations of the world astray. After due consideration, I decided to make you an offer. It's that kind of offer one can't refuse, so think about it carefully.
What offer?

Join me, my son. Cast away those shackles of senseless laws and binding commandments and become my companion. You'll sit on the throne of victors. You'll become a part of the New Order. Nobody else can get as much as I'm offering you!
No, I can't accept such an offer. I can't betray my knightly oath!
Really? I'm very sorry about that, my son. In that case you'll have to be put away as the time is ticking away and I really need to finish the ritual. Farewell, son. See you in Hell!

Really? I'm very sorry about that, my son. In that case you'll have to be put away as the time is ticking away and I really need to finish the ritual. Moreover I have a surprise for you. It's your companion Hugo de Montesque. He's one of my people. I'm sure you won't be surprised if he's going to join me!
But that would be a betrayal!

No, it wouldn't. It'd be just an exchange of your liege lord. What can God offer you? Years of self-denial and life-long asceticism in exchange for eternal life, which you'll get only if you're lucky enough to pass Purgatory and if you don't end up in Hell. You must blindly obey commands and prohibitions to get something about which you don't know anything. What if that eternal life of yours is pretty boring? What if you're not going to pass Purgatory? Have you ever thought about that? I'm offering you life without any restraints—you just need to say yes!
Hmmm... your offer is tempting. Very well, I agree. Let the New Order arise!
Excellent! I knew I could rely on you. Come, join me so we can sing the last litany of the ritual together. The New Order shall rise and we... arrrggghhhhh!!!
Your Holiness, are you alright? My God... you're bleeding!
What... arrggghhhh... can't... ahhhhhhhhh...
Your Holiness... What's wrong? Your Holiness... Damn, he's dead! What could... Eh? Grandmaster Christoffer de Malamert! What are you doing here?

To cut a long story short—as the Dark High Priest of the Cult I'm just working on it!
No, I can't accept such an offer. I can't betray my holy mission!

No, I can't accept such an offer. I can't betray what I believe in!
You must be the author of the Inquisitorial Decree which imbued the Inquisition with rather broad privileges—compared to the other estates, right?

Well, am I the author of the Inquisitorial Decree? Hmmm... yes, I have a feeling I've heard somebody saying it about me. Well, ok... enough joking, it's not appropriate. Yes, it was me who composed the wording of Decretum Inquisitorium. I was sure it'd help to stabilize the Realm, to purify it—even though it might happen through the fires of the executioner's stake if necessary.
Do you think you have achieved that goal, Your Holiness? As I've heard that step brought about significant... hmmm... controversy.

Yes, that's true. Many have risen against the new powers of the Inquisition—the Brotherhood of the Righteous has been loudest of them all. They've been disparaging the Holy Office saying that the Decree serves its own impious purposes. They've been crying out loud that we could abuse our powers to achieve wicked goals contradictory to our mission. What impudence! How could they?!
I don't want to offend you, but I myself have met with several cases of heresy in the ranks of the Inquisition...

That's possible. I myself have heard about such cases and it saddens me that the seed of evil can grow and prosper even in the ranks of the Holy Office. Anyway it is not an argument which could justify the attacks against the noble—and very difficult—mission of the Holy Office. The Church has always been able to purge itself of all evil and to help its nation—this time it won't be any different!
You're right, it's a shame.

You're absolutely correct, son. To doubt the purity of the Inquisition borders on crime! On the other hand, I must admit that the seed of evil and sin can take root even in the ranks of the Holy Office. Anyway it is not an argument which could justify the attacks against the noble—and very difficult—mission of the Holy Office. The Church has always been able to purge itself of all evil and to help its nation—this time it won't be any different!

I'd like to ask you for your opinion about the evidence I have managed to acquire against Cardinal Commendoni. Do you think it could be possible that the Inquisitor General would be involved in plots of a heretic cult?

I don't believe Commendoni to be involved in any plot, son. It must be a mistake. Or even worse, the evidence is fake and then it's obvious how cunning those infernal heretics of Ultherst are. Nevertheless, I refuse to accept that Cardinal Commendoni would be guilty of heresy or of any other crime. He's a stout supporter of the faith and a pillar of the Realm!
Your Holiness, what do you think about the crisis the Realm has been dragged into? Is it the end of days?

Well, the crisis and the end of days... Hmmm... to be honest I've been trying to find an answer to this question since the moment I first saw the Star of Doom in the sky. Even then a shiver ran down my spine in anticipation of things to come which would be filled with crying and gnashing of teeth. If I base my interpretation on the Holy Scripture then I don't have any other option than to cite the Apocalypse of Saint Ezekiel: And the first angel blew his horn and famine came to take one-third of mankind. Crops were rotting, fruit was crawling with worms, and cattle was perishing. And the second angel blew his horn and the Earth was afflicted by a plague which took one-third of mankind. Crying of mothers drowned out roars of thunder and people were falling to their knees despairing. And the third angel blew his horn and the Earth was stricken by rain of stones and of fire falling from the sky to destroy one-third of cities and villages... That day the Kingdom of God on Earth perished and Satan was released from his prison to lead all the nations of the world astray!
So you think that the end of the world is coming, right?

No, not necessarily, son. You must understand that the Revelations of Saint Ezekiel cannot be read as a prophecy but rather as an allegory. At least I interpret this holy text in such way. We must seek to find hidden meanings in it.

I suppose it's a warning that eternal evil is lurking everywhere, threatening us all the time. It's a warning against the Beast, the Tempter, the Great Spirit of the Desert. When I read between the lines I see that if I don't follow the Scriptures and God's commandments, I could allow Satan to be released from his prison. That means to allow him to threaten the Kingdom of God on Earth. That's why we must refrain from doing anything that might threaten the true faith; and we must strive with all our might to lead those who have sinned back to God's herd. Well, at least their souls...
I see... I will think about it!
That would be very appropriate, my dear son.

I don't pay much attention to the rumors spreading among common people—at least if they do not concern clerical issues. Nevertheless if I should consider only facts I can verify, then I must agree with you—a war is indeed coming. The First Knight don Rodrigo de Velacor issued orders to the royal regiments to be put on alert after King Edward's death. Thus horses and drought animals are requisitioned, granaries are being filled, new recruits are conscripted and there are many other military tasks being performed. Only the enemy is not to be found anywhere, which is rather strange when war is about to begin...

I considered Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert to be an honest and noble man who was devoted to the execution of divine justice to which he was obliged after swearing his oath. But what could I think about him after his reaction to Decretum Inquisitorium? He's been inveighing against the new powers of the Holy Office, which is destined to cleanse the Realm of all the wicked and rotten. How could I explain his attacks and assaults? Unfortunately, he forces me to doubt honesty of his intentions and steadfastness of his faith!

Well, as you yourself are a priest, my son, I doubt I could tell you anything new about the Fallen Angels. I'm sure you know as I do that the Fallen Angels are the most terrible servants of the Dark ruler of Hell. They are former angels stricken by divine punishment for their sins—they were, together with Satan the Tempter, plotting betrayal against God Almighty from the dawn of time. The Holy Scriptures say that they were cast down from Heaven to be bound in Hell to suffer there for their sins. Since then they've been trying to get back so they could rule both Earth and Heaven. There are four of them—Arthamon, the Lord of Despair, Baphomet, the Ruler of Madness, Cerdie, the Vile Succubus, and the Archangel Azrael, the advocate of Evil and Satan's emissary.

I've heard that many people lost faith in the credibility of the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous after suspicion that he was a traitor and heretic arose—according to hearsay he might have been trying, with the help of the dark powers, to usurp the power in the Realm. The flame of suspicion has been further fueled by the fact that he has not been seen in public for some time and that he's been hiding at some secret place. That's why even I must express my doubts about his deeds, although it does not have to be heresy...
I'm hunting a heretical cult called the Children of the New Order. Have you heard about it?

I don't think that I, as the head of the Holy Mother Church of the Ultherst Nation, would be the most competent to inform you about heretical cults—it's the mission of the inquisitors, isn't it? Nevertheless I know the name, of course. It was a cult which originated in the Empire in the 10th century. According to rumors it was founded by a certain Lucius; a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet. He prognosticated the end of the world and the birth of a new order—its children were supposed to rule the world by the side of the Lord of Darkness himself. The danger of the cult lay in its ability to permeate all social strata and to infect even the highest ranks of the Church and the nobility of the Empire. Nevertheless, the papal Holy Office managed to discover the heretics in the end and they were all executed in 1021, including Lucius. Then the cult perished and there has been no word about it since.

I've heard that there's a witch living in Schwarzwald; her name is Corin and she has committed all kinds of heinous crimes—cursing of cattle, kidnapping of newborns and recently also murder. A paladin, Richwald d'Blazier, was found turned into stone in Schwarzwald. The rumor is that he was having an affair with the hag who had probably bewitched him and then turned him into stone on whim!

I don't know about any facts that would be hinting at the connection between the royal counselor Verenicus and the case of the murder of Crown Prince Louis that happened two years ago. Two royal chambermaids were convicted of the crime. There isn't—and never was—any doubt about their guilt. Though the truth is that one of those witches stated at first that the royal counselor Verenicus was involved in the murder; nevertheless she took back her testimony and pleaded guilty on all counts.

I'll tell you a legend about the Mansion of Baron Dawn von Blutenreich, my son. Maybe you've seen the house yourself, as it is here in Alvaron—at the very edge of the city. It's rumored that the Baron's unclean spirit resides there—it has been trapped there since the day he was poisoned and cursed by his last—thirteenth—wife. If you'd like to know why the poor man was cursed then know that his wife madly accused him of insane crimes which he had supposedly committed on his previous wives and their children. The Baron's wife testified that she had found them buried in the cellar of the mansion. Well, not even her testimony saved her from the stake, which is a just punishment for all poisoners. Nevertheless before she breathed her last she cursed her husband with a terrible curse which forced his spirit to return to his mansion which soon became a house of horrors.
Keep your money for something more worthwhile than bribes, my dear son!
Answer my question, Your Holiness. Don't think that the Archbishop's mitre will save you from divine wrath...
I sincerely urge you, Your Holiness—answer my question. I'm sure it won't cause anything improper—more to the contrary!
Nobody else could provide a better answer to my question than you, Your Holiness. Please, answer my question.
I would like to ask you some questions, Your Holiness.
As if I didn't foresee that... Ask then, I'm fully at your disposal. And if I couldn't answer some of your questions, please forgive old man his forgetfulness.
I assure you that I could never get tired of listening to your ideas, Your Holiness. It was an honor talking to you.

Hmm... that's possible. Nevertheless I suppose that you'll have to leave now to continue in your holy mission, right? Then don't let yourself be delayed by an old priest, son. God be with you. Who knows, maybe we will have another opportunity to have a word.
Farewell, Your Holiness.
What?! Do you mean demons Arthamon, Baphomet and succubus Cerdie? I don't believe that! It's a crude lie! A blasphemous lie!

It very well might be. Nevertheless we need evidence. The only way to get the evidence we need is to perform the magic rituals which should, according to Cardinal Commendoni, open the gates of the Kingdoms of the Fallen Angels on Earth...

Do you really want to perform those heretical rituals?! I won't allow that! That's heresy! Moreover I don't know how you would be able to perform the rituals—I'm sure Cardinal Commendoni did not describe to you in detail as to how to perform them...
No, he didn't. Nevertheless the ritual should be described in the book Libre Daemonium which was in Commendoni's possession, probably hidden among his personal belongings...
Now I see where you're headed... You want me to allow you to search the belongings of Cardinal Commendoni and if you find the cursed book there to let you keep it, am I right?

To tell the truth, my son, I've already ordered the belongings of Cardinal Commendoni to be confiscated. His cell was searched quite thoroughly as well... I just wanted to be sure that no infernal work was left behind. And among other things there indeed was the book you've mentioned.
Can I ask you to give me the book?

No, son, you can't. That Satan's work will end up at the stake together with all other belongings of that treacherous Cardinal Commendoni. We must cleanse the filth, remove it from the face of Earth! We must not allow anyone to even glimpse the texts that are offending God Himself!
I assure you, Your Holiness, that there's no other way. I know that it borders on heresy, but in this case the end justifies the means...
I'm sorry, son, but this discussion is over. The book shall be burnt together with the other belongings of Cardinal Commendoni. It's God's will!
I beseech you, Your Holiness, please, give me the book.
No, son, I can't. It shall be burnt!
I'll buy the book from you. Name you price...
You can't bribe me, son. As I've said the book shall be burnt!

I warn you, Your Holiness, if you don't hand over the book you might become suspected of heresy. Why would you deny giving me the book if you were innocent? If I don't get the book at once you might end up like Cardinal Commendoni!
What?! You're threatening the patriarch of the Mother Church! That's impudence unheard of!
You make me repeat myself—your hesitation to hand over the book is most suspicious. If you don't give me the book I'll start an investigation against you!

Hmm... you might be right, son. If I didn't give you the book it'd seem as if I were afraid you'd discover my heresy with its help. Nevertheless if you really insist on your statement that the Fallen Angels were summoned to this world, you must have also other proofs than heretical writings...

I have the confessions of Judge Vallarian, Cardinal Truncquillius and even of Cardinal Commendoni himself—they all testified that the Fallen Angels were summoned. I found the places where those wicked rites took place and also the bodies of victims used to summon the demons...

Bodies of victims you say? Did you really find the bodies that were used in the summoning of the Fallen Angels? Hmm... that would be irrefutable evidence indeed. If you brought me the bodies, I'd immediately hand over the book so you could search it thoroughly.
I have the bodies on me, Your Holiness. You can see for yourself how shamelessly they were abused!
Very well, I'll bring the bodies. Perhaps it'll convince you when you see them yourself...
Yes, I'm sure about it. Bring me the bodies and I'll change my opinion. Nevertheless, till then I'm not going to give you the book—it's far too dangerous!
Very well. Farewell.

Oh my God... that's terrifying indeed. Heavens, that stench... Some of the bodies are already decayed beyond recognition. Nevertheless, it is still possible to recognize the wounds caused to them during the infernal rituals. Very well then, you've convinced me. Take the book and study it. Nevertheless, promise me to handle it with utmost caution. You can't know if there's not a temptation within its lines which cannot be resisted. I would be very sad if the book caused your fall!
You don't have to worry, Your Holiness... and thank you.

You don't have to thank me, son—I didn't do you any favor. Nevertheless I'd be glad if you kept me informed about the results of your investigation. I won't be able to rest unless all those suppositions concerning the summoning of the Fallen Angels are disproved.
Rest assured, Your Holiness—as soon as I find out something I'll let you know. Farewell.

By all the saints, where could I have left it? I had it right in my hands a second ago and now it's gone somewhere. Maybe it's over there! No, it's not... Where could I have left it? I can't be that absentminded yet...
Can I ask who you are?
Of course, I'm Archbishop Laurencius, the head of the Holy Mother Church of the Ultherst Nation, my son—well at least if I remember correctly.
You... you are Archbishop Laurencius?! It's an honor to meet you, Your Holiness! I had no idea that...

That the patriarch of the Ultherst Church could be such an absentminded frail old man, right? Well, what can I do... when I die somebody younger and more capable will take my place, I'm sure about it. Nevertheless I hope that I'll stay here for some time yet. After all, I have a feeling that my mission here is not finished yet...
It's an honor to meet you, Your Holiness!

Might be. Well, it also might be otherwise, right? Who can see the intentions behind man's words? The world is full of crafty liars, false prophets and of wolves disguised as sheep... Which of them are you, my son?
I assure you that my intentions are absolutely righteous!

Yes, everybody says that. But after some time spent in the torture chamber everybody tends to spill filth and obscenities from his mouth. No, son, sincerity can't be trusted. The only thing you can trust is evidence. Well, I won't bother you with my mental processes. Tell me, what do you need from me?
Let's say that the wolf disguised as a lamb sounds quite appealing...

I can see you're in a good mood, my son. That's alright. I've always supported the opinion that a cheerful mind is better for coping with the service to God—definitely better than a dismal mind. Nevertheless there is a time and place for everything—don't forget that too much cheerfulness is not very suitable for your position. Well, I won't bother you with strange mental processes of an old man any longer. Tell me, what do you need from me?
It's hard to tell—moreover it'd be just my words and those can lie, as you've yourself said. And what about you, Your Holiness? Do you hide something from the world?

Everybody has his secret, son. Even such an old frail man as me. The only thing that matters is whether the secret is in accordance with divine laws or not. Well, I won't bother you with strange mental processes of an old man any longer. Tell me, what do you need from me?
What are you looking for, Father?

What am I looking for? Well, of course... By all the saints! What am I looking for after all? Well, I had it in my hands a moment ago, I can remember that... Oh, I've finally remembered—I'm looking for the Marital Decree. I needed to consult it because of the case of a certain noble who married his relative in the sixth degree... I don't remember what punishment is there for such a sin.

If I remember correctly, the punishment for an incestuous marriage is not only the nullification of it, but also withholding of heir rights of all the children coming from such a partnership. The sinner himself must do a year-long penance, embark on a pilgrimage to a holy pilgrimage place, or he must pay high indulgences to the Church.
Really? Well, so I don't have to keep looking for it. You've said it very nicely, son. If I only had more counselors like you...
Whatever you're looking for, stop it and pay attention to me!
Very well, as you wish, my son. You're probably coming with a very pressing matter, when you're insisting that much. Well, I'm at your disposal. Go on.
Is it you, my son? Greetings. What brings you here?
I just wanted to ask you if there's something I could do for you.

That's very nice of you, son. But I don't need anything at the moment, thanks. Well, maybe I could use better memory and some vitality, but you can't help me with that. Anyway, it's not that bad yet... I hope. Well, could I ask you in return what I could do for you?
As if I couldn't foresee that... Ask then, I'm fully at your disposal. And if I couldn't answer some of your questions, please forgive old man his forgetfulness.
Nothing, Your Holiness. I'm on my way out.
Then I should bid you godspeed, my son. God be with you.
Nothing, Your Holiness, I was just passing by...
Pity... I thought we would have a chance to chat a bit. Well, never mind, perhaps we'll have another chance. Farewell. God be with you!

My son, I'm so glad to see you alive and well! I heard what happened... It's terrifying! The Inquisitor General a heretic! Moreover with his lair right beneath the Temple of the Holiest Trinity! Oh my God, that's terrifying...
Yes, it is.

We're lucky you managed to reveal him and confront him! Were it not for you, only God knows what terrible atrocities he might have committed... Nevertheless I'm afraid of what will come next. The faith in the Holy Office was undermined as well as the faith in the Holy Mother Church. We will have to work hard to restore its credit...
Yes, I agree. Could I ask you some questions, Your Holiness?
Of course, my son. Go ahead!
Yes, I agree. If you could excuse me now, Your Holiness, I have a pressing matter to attend to.
You're indeed a brilliant example of how selfless the service to God should be. I'm astonished by your performance. God be with you.
Well, that's what I need to discuss with you, Your Holiness... Cardinal Commendoni confessed that he managed to summon the Fallen Angels...
I have the bodies used by the Cult of the Children of the New Order in the rituals during which the Fallen Angels were summoned.
Is it you, my son? I'm glad to see you again. What brings you here?
Of course, ask your questions, I'm fully at your disposal. And if I can't answer some of your questions, please forgive old man his forgetfulness.
I'd like to discuss Cardinal Commendoni with you.
What burdens you, my son? I thought that the case was resolved and closed...
I'm afraid it's not true. There is a suspicion that the Cardinal and his lackeys managed to summon the Fallen Angels...
Is it you, my son? I'm so glad to see you. Have you succeeded in proving the presence of the Fallen Angels in our world?
No, Your Holiness, not yet. Anyway, I'm working on it!
I'm glad to hear that, son. It is absolutely necessary to disprove that grievous suspicion!
I'll do my best. Could I ask you some questions, Your Holiness?
Of course, son. I'm fully at your disposal. And if I can't answer some of your questions, please forgive old man his forgetfulness.
You can rely on me. Farewell.
Godspeed, my son. God be with you.
Unfortunately yes, Your Holiness...
What do you say? You really... God forgive me... you really found the Fallen Angels to reside in our world?! I don't believe that! That can't be true!
I'm sorry to say that, but the presence of the Fallen Angels in our world was proven beyond reasonable doubt!
That's terrible! Unimaginable! That destroys all the teachings regarding the Kingdom of God on Earth! What terrible times have we lived to witness?!
I'll try to handle the situation, Your Holiness. The Fallen Angels must be destroyed!

Yes, they certainly must! Nevertheless I doubt you could succeed—after all to face the Fallen Angels is the same as facing Hell itself! Nevertheless I cannot but admire your courage and persistence. Yes, this is a brilliant example of unswerving execution of God's will. You're carrying your cross as bravely and dauntlessly towards certain death as the First Prophet did. God Himself is watching you, my dearest son. None of your merits shall ever be forgotten, you can be sure about it! Take these few humble potions which should, I believe they will, help you in your holy mission for divine justice!

Is it you, my son? I'm so glad to see you. Did you manage to face the Fallen Angels and defeat them? Did you drive those infernal monsters back to Hell, whence they had come from to violate the divine order?
No, Your Holiness, not yet.

I understand. Nevertheless I hope that your struggle will bear fruit eventually. I'd have never thought that the fate of the entire Realm would be resting on the shoulders of a single man... Your zeal and persistence are admirable!
Thank you. Could I speak with you for a minute?
Of course, my son. What do you need?
Thank you, Your Holiness. Farewell.
Godspeed, my son. God be with you. Remember that you're carrying out divine will!
Partially, Your Holiness. Some of them were destroyed, others have it coming!

I... I can't believe my ears! You... you really destroyed some of the Fallen Angels! Heavens... you're indeed the God's champion! The Archangel Gabriel himself must be protecting you together with all the saints! The news brings tears of joy into my old eyes... Nevertheless we must not forget that the task is not finished yet. Mortal danger is still upon us. You must stop the Fallen Angels no matter the cost!
You can count on me, Your Holiness. Could I speak with you for a minute?
I'll keep that in mind. Farewell.

Can you explain to me, my dearest son, what you have just attempted?! If I were distrustful and suspicious I'd think that you've just tried to steal from me. Fortunately for you, I'm neither and so I won't let you get punished for your impudence. Nevertheless, next time think twice before you act. If you have a feeling that somebody or something is forcing you to perform ill deeds, seek the hospitality of the Holy Inquisition—I'm sure that they'll find the source of your problems. UNDERSTOOD?!

Well, at least their souls...

Take the book and make the will of God. But promise me you will handle it with the utmost caution. You can't know if there's a temptation within its lines which cannot be resisted. I would be very sad if the book caused your fall!

What is going on here?! What is going on here?! What a stupid question, my son. I was sure you managed to reveal and expose everything. You're the great inquisitor, aren't you? So why the hell are you asking me what's going on? Isn't it obvious? Oh, I see it isn't... So let's make a little lesson, shall we? Just to allow your soul to rest in peace. So, the Fallen Angels were summoned, right? Well, the Plan of the Cult mentioned that the Dark Lord would be released from his prison then. Long story short—as the Dark High Priest of the Cult I'm just working on it!

Yes, but it was just a metaphor! I'm sure that you're well aware of the fact that the Fallen Angels are embodiment of three terrible infernal forces—of Despair, Chaos and of Fornication. It's so to allow people to better comprehend their nature. They must be shown something physical to believe that it's dangerous for them. They must believe that somewhere deep in Hell is a hideous being with countless teeth and claws to be afraid of it and to live humbly. That was the concept of your Church—and I must say that it was rather clever. Nevertheless in the end it caused that people couldn't comprehend the meaning and focused only on the form. And as you have been probably already taught in your life, form is tricky!

Son, you're a hopeless case it seems. You've been investigating the greatest case of heresy and conspiracy in the history of the Realm and now when you discover the main culprit you have no idea what it was all about. Anyway, I'm going to explain it to you because I want to ask you a single question which you wouldn't be able to answer without comprehending everything. Very well—the summoning of the Fallen Angels mentioned in the Plan of the Dark Prophet Lucius was not intended to bring their physical projection into our world but rather to invoke the infernal powers they represent. That means Satan will be summoned regardless of the physical presence of Arthamon, Baphomet or Cerdie in our world—the only thing that matters are their infernal powers. And those have been irrecoverably unleashed! Just look around and tell me, do your really think that there's still the Kingdom of God on Earth as described by the Holy Scriptures? I don't think so—just the contrary. I can see only mortal sins—one alongside another. People are killing each other, they're giving to fits of rage and are fornicating with each other regardless of law or order. That's what I call Hell!

Because we needed to take the attention of the people away from the true objective of the Plan. That's why I summoned all the Dark Priests early this year to start a big show after several hundreds years of waiting. In fact it was not really necessary as its objective was just to attract the attention of all the defenders of the Realm and of divine order. As you can see it worked out without a hitch.

No, my son—that's brilliant! You'll see for yourself real soon. As you can see, the Dark Prophet Lucius planned and prepared everything to the tiniest detail—of course with the assistance from the Fallen Archangel Azrael. All that needed to be done was to wait for the right moment. The Holy Scripture, the Revelation of Saint Ezekiel—to be more specific, says that Satan will be released from his prison after thousand years. Of course it's a nonsense which was introduced by Ezekiel's imagination, or better to say by delirium tremens caused by unrestrained drinking. Nevertheless, common people were influenced greatly. As soon as the year 1223 started to loom, people began to be scared of the end of the world, because they believed that the beginning of God's Kingdom on Earth dated back to 223 when the pagan Empire of Ereborn fell and faithful kingdoms were born. Of course that's nonsense as well. But it was an opportunity we could not just let go!

Yes, that's right. Nevertheless it's again just nonsense invented by that old fool Ezekiel. Nevertheless it came in handy. I knew that the Star of Doom would appear above Ultherst in 1219—in fact it is a comet returning to our world every thousand years. As you can see, I'm not a rigid supporter of the idea that the world is flat and that it's floating in the middle of the space as states the Church doctrine. The fact that I opened my mind to new scientific discoveries allowed me to prepare everything necessary. You can't imagine how easy it was, with my new knowledge, to cause bad crops, plague and even the rain of fire—it was just a clever combination of magic and of alchemy. Master Theil Brechthold, the former royal alchemist, helped me greatly with all that—I believe you would have met him in Hillbrandt. He's a great scientist!
My God... was it then all set up?

You're absolutely correct, my son. As you can see, even Evil must be helped lest we want it to remain only in the lines of poems and novels. Nevertheless it worked unbelievably well—the people were persuaded that the end of the world was nigh and by their foolish, unrestrained behavior they themselves introduced the infernal powers of despair, chaos and fornication into the world. That was the moment Satan had been waiting for. Now he can enter this world as it's ready for his rule. Now he's going to be born in Prince Louis to sit on the Ultherst throne, from which he shall lead all the nations of the world astray!

Exactly, my son. Nevertheless, considering the fact that you're the only one here and that the ritual is almost finished, it'd have to be you. Well, and that brings me to the question I wanted to ask you. You performed really well in your investigation and you achieved admirable results. It certainly required great courage to face Judge Vallarian and Cardinal Truncquillius, let alone your deeds when investigating Cardinal Commendoni. It'd be to the detriment of our cause to lose you, as our work is just about to begin today. It won't be easy to disrupt all the faithful kingdoms and to lead all the nations of the world astray. After due consideration, I decided to make you an offer. It's that kind of offer one can't refuse, so think about it carefully.

Fortunately for you, I'm neither and so I won't let you be punished for your impudence. Nevertheless, next time think twice before you act. If you have a feeling that somebody or something is forcing you to perform ill deeds, seek the hospitality of your fellow brother inquisitors—I'm sure that they'll find the source of your problems. UNDERSTOOD?!

Hmm... that's possible. Nevertheless I suppose that you'll have to leave now, right? Then don't let yourself be delayed by an old priest, son. God be with you. Who knows, maybe we will have another opportunity to have a word.

Can you explain to me, my dearest son, what have you just attempted?! If I were distrustful and suspicious I'd think that you've just tried to steal from me. Fortunately for you, I'm neither and so I won't let you get punished for your impudence. Nevertheless, next time think twice before you act. If you have a feeling that somebody or something is forcing you to perform ill deeds, seek the hospitality of the Holy Inquisition, I'm sure that they'll find the source of your problems. UNDERSTOOD?!
So, you want to do some shopping. I must say I like that—money must circulate, hasn't it?
Get to the point, please.

But of course... it depends on what you want to buy, knight. Leon van den Brooks has his renowned armory here in Alvaron. Thelma Ulthraum, the apothecary, and Alberto Kelley, Master Alchemist, offer some potions and various magic goods. Also William Burton, the landlord, and Salena Flock, the innkeeper, have shops with a wide range of goods.

I didn't know the renowned Brotherhood of the Righteous is interested in weather. What would you do if you found out the storm really occurred? Would you arrest it and accuse it of the spoiling of nice weather?
You'd better stop offending me and answer the question!
Well, what was the question about? It seems I don't remember it...
Now you can see how easy it is for us!
If there was some wild storm here.
Oh, I see... no, I don't remember any. But it's possible it occurred during the night and I slept through it—my sleep's very sound, you know...

If I were you, I wouldn't go to the city cemetery after dusk, knight—I mean, it's really flooded with evil! Living dead feast there on graves and coffins during nights, ghosts fly through the graveyard air and a nameless horror creeps in dark shadows. Whoever goes there, nobody will see him again—only as one of the living dead...
How do you know all this? Have you been there after dusk?

Good question. I can see you're a man in the right place. But I must disappoint you—usually I sleep like a top from the early evening. As for what happened in the cemetery, I've only heard about it from people. So it's possible nothing happened there after all. But I'm not going to find out...
Not at all, knight. As you can see, I like to cooperate with the Brotherhood of the Righteous. That is, I admire your work. Do you have any other questions for me?
So you need some extra money and you are looking for information about rewards because of that, right? Don't you Paladins get the property of executed criminals?
Well, we do, but I spend the money too quickly...

I know this well, knight. However, I don't think that killing beasts for reward is a good job. But it's your decision, after all. If you want to make some money, go to Schwarzwald and hunt some werewolves there. Or wait here in the city streets for the full moon—each full moon those hairy beasts somehow succeed in getting in. And when you have a werewolf head, go and give it to Sheriff Portmann, who will pay you some gold as a reward. Grand Duke Drake Lambert thinks that thanks to the reward the number of werewolves in the pack of wolf prince Wulfhyrr will decrease fiercely. But I'd say he made a terrible mistake.
Don't be arrogant and answer the question...

Nothing special happened here lately... Only that Edward was murdered, not long ago. I mean King Edward the Second. The ruler of the Realm. Last member of the ruling dynasty. Just in the middle of the royal palace. What a disaster! Who could have foreseen that? Can you imagine that? It was willful murder!

I'm sorry, but I don't answer such questions on principle. 'Cause I don't want to bring about the danger of prosecution neither to myself nor to a person dear and close... And by causing a prosecution to a person not dear and close to me I'd cause a danger for myself that the person would go and stick fifteen inches of steel into my belly. And I really wouldn't like that very much...
Oh my God, what trash do you collect, knight? What—Bethel Tamperum? And you call yourself a Paladin?!
Well... forget about it...
I've never heard about such a thing... Bethel Tamperum... he he he.
Answer the question!

I don't know any Bethel Tamperum and I don't have a slightest idea where to get such a thing—and the same it is as for the other trash... Bethel Tamperum... I've never heard about such a thing, he he he.
What?! What did you ask about?
If there are any tales or legends connected to Alvaron and to its surroundings...
I see... I thought I heard wrong, but I hadn't. You want me to tell you some legends about here?

Well, you'd have to excuse me, knight, I'm too sober for something like that. But we could go to a pub some day and talk there about headless knights, dragons, ogres, kelpies, banshees and about haunts so long that you would be sick of the chat...
Forget it...
Very gladly I will... For it seemed to me that you wanted me to tell you some fairy tales, ha ha.
If I can give you some advice, you'd do better if you give me the answer. You can't imagine how bad things could happen to you otherwise... Or do you think you can?
You probably don't suppose I'm a person you can talk freely about any matter. But I assure you, your answer won't do any harm to anyone.
I don't understand why is such an experienced and wordly-wise man like you hesitating to answer a question of a humble priest...
All right, I'll buy the amulet.
In that case you'll give me 1,500 gp, knight. I must admit the price is quite high, but you must appreciate it's a really great jewel!
Unfortunately I don't have enough gold.
Here you are. You can check it.
Old Vick Length believes you, knight. I'm sure knights don't cheat in business. The amulet is yours!
Thanks. Could I talk to you for a moment?
But of course, knight. There's nothing better than a friendly talk after a good business. What do you need from old Vick Length?

In that case I'm afraid the agreement is impossible. I'm not going to give you any discount—not even a single gold piece. I'm sorry. But if you change your mind, let old Vick Length know. Because that's me, you know.
We'll see. Could I talk to you for a moment now?
But of course, knight. What do you need from old Vick Length?
As you think. Farewell.
Vick Length, I arrest you on the basis of reasonable suspicion for grave robbery. You'll come with me to be put before a fair trial!
Grave robbery? I don't know a thing about it. It seems to be a mistake of some kind...
I assure you it's no mistake at all. I have proof of your crimes!

Well the proof must be fake, knight. I'm innocent. I don't know anything about any graves. And I think that the pagan dog Ihmana ab Sahab plotted it against me. I'm sure you've already heard about him—he buys and sells antiquities, as I do. Probably it's some kind of revenge, because his business is quite poor...
That's not important—you're under arrest. Let's go!
As you wish, knight. But you'll see I'm innocent. And one more thing, you'll be bitterly sorry about this, be sure you will!
If you are innocent, it will be found at the trial for sure. Let's go!
As you wish, knight. But remember, you'll be bitterly sorry about this, be sure you will!

Hello, knight. Could you come here for a moment? You seem to be a well-read man, interested in history... do you want to buy this amulet? It is a high-grade quality work of an ancient Elenian master, I'm sure about that! Look at those complicated ornaments and at the writings—it's a unique work, at least several millennia old. Well, won't you buy it?
I'm not interested in antiquities. But I'd like to know who you are.
It's your choice... but it's a shame for you. However, if you change your mind, let old Vick Length know and he will sell it to you. Because old Vick Length, that's me, you know.
Nice to meet you. Can I ask you what do you do for a living?

Well... why are you interested in such a thing? These days, everybody does that in which he's the best at for a living, doesn't he? But I can tell you as I've nothing to hide—I'm in the antiquity business.
Interesting. Could I interrupt your business for a moment and talk to you, for a while?
And where do you get the goods you sell?
Is this an interrogation or what? I'm not going to tell you where the goods are from, because it's a business secret. But it isn't anything illegal, you can trust me!
I understand. Could I talk to you for a moment?
I understand. I have to say goodbye for now. Farewell.
Farewell, knight. And if you change your mind about that Elenian amulet, you know where old Vick Length can be found...
Could I talk to you for a moment? I've got a couple of questions...
It was nice meeting you, good man. But I'll have to be going now.
Farewell then, knight. And think about that amulet...
Where did you get the amulet?

That's not your business, knight. You understand—it's a business secret. But OF COURSE it's not stolen... if that is what you wanted to know. Well, are you interested or not? I've a lot of buyers, so you should decide quickly...

To tell the truth, I have a suspicion this amulet was stolen from an Elenian crypt of a certain noble—En'Lenius, who was woken from his eternal sleep because of that awful robbery... Do you happen to know anything about it?!
No, I don't know anything about it. I'm sure this amulet wasn't stolen! Well, are you interested in it or not?
Hello, knight. Haven't you changed your mind about that amulet yet? I still have it for sale, although several other buyers are interested in it too...
No, thanks. I only need to talk to you for a moment...
As you wish, knight. What do you have in mind? How can old Vick Length help you?
No, thanks. Farewell.
Hail to you, knight. What can old Vick Length do for you?
Nothing, thanks. Farewell.

Get your dirty hands off, knight. Can you hear me?! Once more you try to steal something from me and I promise you I'll introduce a ten-inch steel blade to your guts! And don't think that your Brotherhood of Righteous will stop me—holy shit!
