This spell causes confusion of danger 10+1d$$X$$ that leads to disorientation and lowers the target's Chance to hit an opponent or cast a spell.\\n\\nThis spell can affect any being.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the spell lasts.\\n\\nOrder is a fundamental pillar of the Kingdom of God on Earth. Without order, the world would turn to chaos which is a basic element of Hell. To keep order it is important that the faithful stay strong in their faith. Therefore the heretics have always tried to weaken the faith of the faithful by confusing their minds. In the end, they found a way to confuse a person and make him or her feel fuzzy and clueless by the use supernatural powers.

This spell causes fear of danger $$X$$+1d$$X$$ and makes the target run in panic.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being and at a higher mastery level of the caster it affects all the beings in the area of effect.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the easier the spell penetrates its victim's mind.\\n\\nFear and terror are powerful weapons of heretics in their campaign for destruction of the Kingdom of God on Earth. They do not hesitate to use infernal powers to plant fear into the minds of the faithful by showing them the worst sufferings imaginable because planting the seed of fear in the hearts of the faithful undermines the pillars of the Kingdom of God on Earth. Who could possibly stand to watch the worst things that could happen to him?

This spell causes 5+2d$$X$$ of Frost Damage and $$X$$ Stamina loss.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the higher the Damage inflicted and the Stamina loss.\\n\\nContact with the Afterworld has always been forbidden, for as the First Prophet said—what is dead shall rest in peace in its grave forever. Nevertheless, the heretics have always attempted to use the powers of the Afterworld to their own benefit. And after the many centuries lasting abuse of the powers of the Afterworld, the Breath of Death spell has evolved that uses mortal cold of the dead to hurt the living.

This spell causes $$X$$d6 of Physical Damage.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the higher damage is caused.\\n\\nOne of the fundamentals of the Holy Mother Church's teachings is the teaching of the uniqueness of the world created by God in His infinite wisdom. This teaching is frequently subverted by heretical scriptures which talk about two worlds—the material and the nonmaterial, so called astral, worlds. By visiting the Astral Worlds, the heretics have gained the ability to use the powers which dwell there with a single purpose—to hurt. Over time, the Astral Attack spell has evolved from these abilities.

This spell causes $$X$$+2d6 of Physical Damage and the disease of danger $$X$$.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being in the area of effect.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more dangerous the disease is and the more damage it inflicts.\\n\\nThis spell summons a huge swarm of flies of the Sarcophaga Carnivoria genus who feed mainly on flesh. It is an extremely aggressive genus with remarkably well developed digestive system that injects their extremely corrosive saliva into their fodder to melt it into a liquid which they then feed on. The magical formula works on the principle of evocation of infernal monsters who spread the eggs of Sarcophaga Carnivoria around to destroy the divine order. This spell causes the monsters to summon a number of adult flies which immediately attack all poor victims in the area of effect of this spell.

This spell causes 2*$$X$$+1d6 of Physical Damage whereas 1/4 of this damage turns into Hit Points added to the caster.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the bigger damage the spell causes and the more Hit Points the caster gains.\\n\\nVampirism is a disgusting example of the Infernal Magic, the abuse of powers with the intention to cause a person Physical Damage and to use this damage to one's benefit. The name of the spell was derived from the ability of vampires to suck blood of their victims taking their life energy from them and transferring it into the body of the vampire. This spell works on the same principle—it summons a vortex of infernal powers which remove the life energy from the body of the victim and transfer it to the caster.

This spell causes a reduction of the target's Strength and Constitution which may eventually lead to the being's death. If an object like a door, chest or barrel is the target of this spell, it is irreversibly destroyed.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being or object like a door, chest or barrel.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the higher the reduction of Strength and Constitution is. The amount of Mana necessary to cast the spell decreases as well.\\n\\nDecay is an infernal element, for it is the opposite of creation which is a manifestation of God the creator. That is why decay became a cornerstone of heretical teachings, for it leads to destruction and disorder which can be used to commit even worse abominations. And since everything—including people and their faith—can become a subject of decay, this spell focuses on the decay of the matter—both living and non-living.

This spell infects all the targets with plague of danger 1,5*$$X$$.\\n\\nThis spell affects any being in the area of effect.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more dangerous the plague infection is.\\n\\nPlague is a disease for which there is no cure in the whole faithful world (except maybe for divine intervention). Many of the faithful fell victim to the disease in the past millennium. The last time Ultherst was struck by a plague epidemic, was in 1221 and only thanks to the divine providence it has not spread to other faithful kingdoms. The general opinion has it that plague is a disease of supernatural origin—probably a revenge of Satan for his exile from Heaven although some distinguished contemporary medics do not agree. Whatever the truth is, the heretics are able to summon plague using their infernal powers and use it to promote their unholy plans.

This spell causes an instant death of the target as long as it is on a lower level than the caster +$$X$$!\\n\\nThis spell affects any being.\\n\\nIt is obvious that the heretics have studied ways of depriving a human of his life—the ways which use forbidden knowledge in the first place. For a long time however, they could not find a formula which would separate a soul from its body in one step. Legend has it that the formula was eventually discovered by a lecherous monk Tarnapopulois in the 7th century who wanted to get rid of his wife. The spell creates ruptures in the wholeness of the body and the soul into which infernal claws sink and rip the soul out of the body forever.

This spell causes $$X$$+3d$$X$$ of Physical Damage per second during the time it lasts.\\n\\nThis spell affects all beings in the area of effect.\\n\\nThe Dance of the Dead is probably the most powerful spell of the Pagan Magic from the group of spells which use the powers of the Afterworld. It is based on recitation of forbidden formulas which if told in the right order open the gates of the underworld for a short period of time and call the souls of the dead to dance a wild dance of hatred with the living which tortures their souls. Many weaker beings can be tortured to death this way!

This spell causes intoxication of danger $$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more drunk the target gets.\\n\\nIf the mind of faithful is firm and unspoiled it is hard for a heretic to find a way to do harm and plant the seed of doom where order flourishes. One of the means of weakening one's mind and blurring one's sense is alcohol—if it is used in an unsanctified way. It is, however, rather difficult to get a faithful drunk on sight. Therefore the heretics searched for a way to conjunct the effects of alcohol with supernatural powers which they finally managed in the form of the Intoxication spell. The spell will create ruptures in the willpower of the target through which the filthy substance is poured into his body.

This spell adds bonus +$$X$$% to Fire Immunity.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the higher the bonus is and the longer the spell lasts.\\n\\nThe worshippers of infernal powers must be prepared that the faithful will set traps in their way and hunt them down and that they will not hesitate to use fire whether it is for burning the heresy convicts, hot iron in a torture chamber or flames of justice at the stake. For that reason, infernal powers gave their followers the ability to temporarily raise a shield around themselves to make them more resistant against fire.

This spell causes poisoning of danger 10+$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more dangerous the poison is.\\n\\nPoisons and acids are considered infernal elements and are (in contradiction with the discoveries of modern alchemy) attributed to the fallen angel Arthamon although he is primarily the Lord of Fire. That is why poisons and acids are so popular with the heretics who use them both in a material and nonmaterial sphere. The Poisonous Saliva spell, which can materialize a mixture of poison and acid around the target to cause him serious damage, belongs to the latter.

This spell will cause insanity of danger $$X$$+1d$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the higher the danger of insanity is.\\n\\nIf the mind of a faithful has been struck with insanity he cannot be expected to protect the true faith and tKingdom of God on Earth any longer. The insane becomes a burden to the faith and to society, for a spoiled mind cannot act in accordance with the divine order which is the basic element of the Kingdom of God on Earth. Obviously, making a faithful insane became a major aim of heretics and devil worshippers. The only spell which has been formed and written down up to nowadays creates ruptures in the psychological balance of the target and evokes doubts and a fit of self-reflection in the target causing him temporary insanity.

This spell causes the target 1d$$X$$ points of Physical Damage in the course of its duration.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the spell lasts.\\n\\nThis heretical spell has been sacrilegiously named after the crown which was put on the head of the First Prophet by the soldiers of Ereborn after his crucifixion in the year 33 of the New Era. The crown was braided of thorny twigs of a locust shrub and the Erebornians put it on the head of the dying prophet to worsen his suffering and to ridicule him by pronouncing him the king of the Kingdom of God on Earth, the coming of which the First Prophet prophesied. During the following centuries, the heretics mastered an infernal formula which causes their target physical suffering and called this disgusting spell the Thorn Crown.

This spell paralyzes the target for the time of its duration.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the spell lasts.\\n\\nTo deprive someone of freedom of movement is a manifestation of bad will typical of heretics and devil worshippers. If a faithful cannot move freely how can he defend the faith? With this idea on their minds, the devil's servants searched for a formula enabling them to bind their opponents. The outcome of their attempts was the Frost spell which paralyses the muscles of the target using the deadly Afterworld cold, temporarily preventing him from moving.

This spell temporarily causes the target to become an enemy of all.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the spell lasts. Also the amount of Mana required to cast the spell decreases.\\n\\nIf somebody is possessed by an evil spirit he cannot be a pillar of the faith and becomes dangerous to his surroundings, for the unholy powers which control him can do anything they like with him. For that reason, the daemon summoning rituals are so popular with the heretics and devil worshippers. If the ritual is successful, almost anybody can become possessed by an unholy spirit which will make him the Dark Prince's and his followers' instrument. The Possession spell falls into such category of spells by its nature.

This spell will summon a number of dogs who will protect the caster against his opponents.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the hellspawns remain in this world.\\n\\nThe fight against heresy and the heretics is as old and as uncompromising as the faith itself. Considering that there has always been more faithful than those who turned away from the teachings of the Holy Mother Church and stopped believing in the Omnipotent God, the heretics have always tried to get help from hellspawns who would protect them from the traps of the faithful at time of the biggest need. That is why the Infernal Hounds spell was created. This spell will summon infernal hounds of the Dark Prince's pack.

This spell causes $$X$$+3d$$X$$ of Fire Damage per second during the time it lasts.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nFire is one of the basic infernal elements although it is often used for protection of the true faith and other holy activities as well. It is, however, in its principle a destructive and therefore an infernal element associated with the fallen angel Arthamon. It is he who lends his infernal power to the one who says the magical formula of this spell correctly to burn everything living in the line of sight. If the caster succeeds, flames burst out of the ground burning everything in their way.

This spell causes $$X$$d6 points of Fire, Poison, Lightning and Frost Damage respectively.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect of this spell can be the target.\\n\\nOne of the main aims of heretics is summoning the infernal monsters they worship and serve in return for fulfilling their lowly wishes. Summoning infernal monsters is not easy at all, for the Kingdom of God on Earth is protected from them by the faith of the faithful. Yet the heretics are often able to penetrate this protection and summon the monsters by joining the powers of more people at sabbaths and dark masses. It is there that they can contact the Dark Prince and call his spawns to do harm. From the concentration of metaphysical loathing of the true faith and compulsive desire for the presence of infernal powers one of the most powerful infernal spells called the Dark Mass was created. This spell can in a single moment create the same infernal air around the caster that is there during the sabbaths which causes damage to all the beings in the line of sight.

This spell identifies all unidentified items.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the better the spell penetrates.\\n\\nKnowing the surrounding world and the items it consists of enables one to understand life. That is very important for an inquisitor who as a soldier of God has to pass many tests which require such knowledge. For that reason, the Inquisitorial Magic focuses on uncovering and using the knowledge of the material part of the world. The Sixth Sense is one of the simplest spells which can examine the metaphysical projection of the immaterial part of any material item and identify its imprint reliably.

This spell causes $$X$$d4 points of Physical Damage to the target.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the bigger damage this spell causes.\\n\\nHealing power which heals and cures wounds is the basic manifestation of divine power and mercy. But this principle can be reversed as well through the just divine wrath as it is understood and used by the Inquisitorial Magic. The powers which can heal wounds through Our Lord can be turned to His angry side and hurled at a being which is not worth His kindness to cause damage to it as a punishment for the committed sins.

This spell inflicts curse of danger $$X$$/2+1d$$X$$ upon the target.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more dangerous the curse is.\\n\\nDivine wrath is a horrible weapon in the hands of the inquisitors. Of course, God is merciful and offers His kind arms to all the lost sheep, but to those who turned into the wolves and are hurting the herd He can offer nothing but just wrath. And this is frequently used by the Inquisitorial Magic. The Curse spell uses the power of divine wrath to let the target know the other side of divine grace.

This spell will light the area around the caster increasing his Perception skill.\\n\\nOnly a caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the spell lasts. The bonus to reaction increases as well.\\n\\nWhere darkness rules the sin flourishes says the Holy Scripture. Darkness is an infernal element, for it represents the absence of the purifying and redeeming light as a divine creation. Light amends everything bad and it is a symbol of forgiveness and new beginning. It is one of the basic elements of the Inquisitorial Magic and its use in the fight against heretics is variable and effective. The basic formula which operates on this principle is the Light spell which by metaphysical transubstantiation of the psychological element of aura turns the caster into a source of light.

This spell will temporarily cause blindness with all its negative effects.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the blindness last.\\n\\nEyesight is a sense most of the living—and very often the unliving as well—beings use for orientation. It is elemental for recognition as well as for orientation without which most of the beings turn to helpless puppets. A sight-deprived being cannot defend and is easily defeated. The protectors of the faith have always known this and therefore focused on this path of magic. Using a strong flash of light, the Blindness spell can temporarily deprive the target of vision. The effect is very strong although only temporary.

This spell will temporarily paralyze the target.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer the paralysis lasts.\\n\\nCrucifixion was a common method of execution at the times of the Empire of Ereborn. Considering that the first faithful, including all the thirteen prophets, were executed by crucifixion, it was banned right at the first synod of the faithful bishops after the downfall of Ereborn in 225. At the times when the Inquisitorial Magic started to develop and take its shape, a spell was created which could run metaphysical currents around the target, so that he had to stay at one spot without moving as if crucified, and it was named Crucifixion.

This spell causes 10+10d$$X$$ points of Physical Damage to the target.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the bigger damage the spell causes.\\n\\nStoning was, as well as crucifixion, a method of execution typical of Ereborn. And as well as crucifixion it was prohibited after the downfall of Ereborn because it was a pagan barbarism. When Inquisitorial Magic was being created, stoning was partially rehabilitated in the form of a spell which can materialize several stones of different sizes above the target which will then fall on its head. It is an extremely effective and extremely painful way of killing somebody.

This spell makes the target invisible but with several limitations.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the longer duration the invisibility has.\\n\\nInvisibility has always been fascinating to both sides in the fight of good and evil. The idea that one can become invisible thus being able to move and do whatever he likes has appealed to the heretics but their experiments with the supernatural powers never brought any result. The protectors of the faith on the contrary managed to come up with a magical formula which disperses the rays of light resulting in almost perfect invisibility. There are some catches, however. The invisible person cannot speak, move rapidly or cast spells otherwise he will become visible.

This spell causes the target to become an enemy of all the beings in its surroundings.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nStigma is a name of a supernatural phenomenon—the sudden appearance of the wounds connected to the death of the thirteen prophets on somebody's body. According to the teachings of the Holy Mother Church, they are the results of a connection of a person's faith with the legacy of the prophets who gave their lives for the true faith and redeemed the following generations from the sin of paganism. In the hands of inquisitors, Stigma became a name for a magic formula which will mark the targets body (disregarding his faith) with a stigma of divine wrath making him an enemy of any being that sees him.

This spell causes 5*$$X$$d10 points of Fire Damage.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nIf a body of a heretic is turned to dust he can no longer be a threat to the faith or the Holy Mother Church. That is one of the most important dogmas based on the idea that if something does not exist it cannot do anything. Therefore the Inquisition searched for a formula which could instantly turn a heretic's body to dust, for such a formula would have been a great contribution in the fight for the protection of faith. And success came in 888 when at the execution of the self-appointed dark prophet Lucius of the cult of the Children of the New Order the stake was so wet with rain that it could not be lit up. The Inquisitor General Santini burst out with such an anger that he lit up the stake and a few people around it with a single word.

This spell adds a $$X$$% bonus to Frost Resistance.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of this spell and the Frost Resistance increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nAlthough fire is the main infernal element, heretics also know many spells based on the use of deadly frost. That is why the Magic of True Faith focuses on the protection against such effects as well. This spell uses the natural body temperature of the caster, increases it several times and creates a shield which lowers the effects of Frost.

This spell cures all the diseases the target suffers from if the danger of the diseases is lower than $$X$$/2+1d$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more the spell is effective and the more dangerous diseases it can cure.\\n\\nProtection of a faithful against anything evil which can terminate his life prematurely is a basic aim and a function of the Magic of True Faith. The Cure Disease spell is amongst such spells, for if somebody's body suffers from a disease the mind and the soul suffer as well because he cannot fulfill the duties of a true faithful. The formula of the spell turns to divine mercy and summons angelic powers of salvation which can purge the body of the malign seeds of the disease.

This spell purges the body of the target of all negative conditions if the danger of the negative effects is lower than 20+$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more dangerous conditions the spell can remove. The casting time is reduced as well.\\n\\nIf a faithful is not paying attention his body and mind can be affected by a number of infernal and negative influences. It is not at all easy to get rid of these especially if they are curses and dark spells. To purge one of such bad condition, a magical formula has been created which summons the powers of divine mercy that purify the body and mind of the suffering one.

This spell decreases the Physical Damage of the target by $$X$$%.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Physical Damage Resistance increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nA faithful is frequently exposed to the danger of losing his life or being wounded these days. Mortally dangerous traps which smell of devil and sulfur await everywhere. The thinkers realized this and created a magical formula which summons protective powers of God and braids them into a protective net which merges with the physical body of the faithful making him more resistant to wounds.

This spell increases Magic Resistance of the target by 2*$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of the spell and the Magic Resistance increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nFaith represents not only the spiritual but also the metaphysical protection in the widest meaning of the word. When the faithful is strong enough, he is protected not only from the seduction of devil but from the astral attacks done mainly by evil spells as well. The Spiritual Shield spell is based on this principle which thanks to a well formed formula concentrates metaphysical manifestations of faith, distills them to a physical matter, multiplies it and forms a kind of spiritual shield which protects its bearer from magical attacks.

This spell removes the effects of any spell previously cast on the target.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast the spell decreases with the increasing mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nNo matter how careful a faithful is, he can always become a target of evil spells cast by filthy heretics or hellspawns. In such situation, every kind of help is highly appreciated, for many such spells can cause severe wounds, death or even worse things. Therefore the thinkers who were creating the Magic of True Faith searched for a formula which could remove the spell effects from its target. Their efforts were finally rewarded by success in the form of this spell which however has one disadvantage and that is that it does not distinguish between good and evil spells.

This spell causes $$X$$d20 points of serious Lightning Damage on the target.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast this spell decreases with the increasing mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe Holy Scripture is full of images where a sinner is punished for acting against the divine order. The idea that a sinner could be punished for his sin instantly on the spot has always been very attractive to the mystics and they made a lot of effort to transfer the images of the Holy Scripture to a formula which kills anybody who speaks ill of God. The Lightning spell was thus created which materializes a ball of energy and directs it at the body of the target in the form of lightning.

This spell exiles any undead or demonic being from this world if their level is lower than the level of the caster +$$X$$.\\n\\nAny undead or demonic being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast this spell decreases with the increasing mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nIn the infernal world, many demons, fallen souls and unholy powers dwell which long to come to our world to commit all kinds of atrocities and abominations. For the same reason they are frequently summoned by heretics and devil worshippers which brings the Kingdom of God on Earth to chaos and disorder. It is a holy duty of each faithful to search for such hellspawns and send them back to the burning hell. The exorcist spell Exile which breaks the protective shield of a hellspawn and exiles it from this world by a blow of spiritual power serves this purpose.

This spell causes the caster to be invisible to the undead and demonic creatures unless he attacks them or casts a spell.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nIf a faithful's life is jeopardized by an imminent attack of hellspawns or their disgusting human servants, his only hope often is to pray for an intervention from heaven or the saints. Not regarding whether such an act actually brings some protection or not, the faithful thinkers worked with this idea and created this spell. It forms a spiritual shield around the caster which hides him from the sight of the demonic and undead foes.

This spell temporarily paralyzes the target.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThere is a story in the Holy Scripture which tells of prophet Kassmiel's wife who turned into a pillar of salt because she disobeyed her husband's bidding not to turn back to see what has happened to the cursed city of the sodomites. It was a manifestation of divine wrath which strikes all who disobey God's bidding. This chapter of the Holy Scripture had such an influence on thinkers who were creating the principles of the Magic of True Faith that they found a formula which does exactly the same thing that happened to Kassmiel's wife—it turns the target to a pillar of salt. The only disadvantage of this spell is that its effects are only temporary.

This spell adds +2*$$X$$ bonus to attack and penetration of the spells cast.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of this spell increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nAnything done in the name of God is done with God's blessing. Therefore everything that must be done in the name of the savior must necessarily be worth blessing. This idea contributed to the creation of the Bless spell which helps the faithful by increasing their ability to cast spells using the spiritual influence of the currents of metaphysical fundamentals of the faith. Temporarily of course.

This spell increases the speed of Stamina regeneration.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of the spell and the speed of Stamina regeneration increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nIf one's body is weak his mind is weak as well, says the Holy Scripture. It is true that the condition of the body is closely interconnected with the condition of mind and spirit which always have to be prepared to resist the seduction of devil. Therefore the thinkers who were creating the principles of the Magic of True Faith focused on creating this spell to protect the body from exhaustion, for this spell strengthens the person and protects him from fainting. The Endurance spell removes exhaustion from the target using the powers of divine mercy.

This spell temporarily adds 2*$$X$$ bonus to Magic Resistance of the target and with the increasing mastery level also the bonuses to Poison, Fire and Lightning Resistances.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Magic, Poison, Fire and Lightning Resistance bonus increases with the mastery level of the caster. The duration of the spell increases as well.\\n\\nThe Holy Scripture says that the First Prophet was a human son of the Omnipotent God which endowed him with such a strong faith that no other human in the world could ever be so strong in faith as him. However, everyone should try to fulfill the legacy of the First Prophet who prophesied hope and salvation to people. Faith is the most precious gift from God and it was given to protect one from hell as well as to make sure that one's soul finds eternal salvation. This basic theological thesis was transferred by the spiritual fathers into a magical formula which can multiply one's faith and transfer it into a form of metaphysical power.

This spell heals 10+$$X$$d4 Hit Points.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe number of healed Hit Points increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nAccording to the Holy Scripture, the First Prophet had the power to heal deadly wounds inflicted by a pagan living in sin without the blessing of faith. This power was attributed to divine mercy which the First Prophet was able to summon through the power of strong faith. This principle was used by the spiritual thinkers who created the Divine Magic and led to the creation of a magical formula which heals inflicted wounds by summoning healing powers.

This spell will temporarily increase Lightning Resistance.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nLightning Resistance and the spell duration increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nLightning is a symbol of divine wrath but it can be used to bring harm to the true faithful as well. However since it is a divine element, the thinkers were able to analyze its essence and create a magical formula which is able to decompose the lightning into many flows of energy and deflect them into several directions so that they do not do any harm.

This spell transfers a part of the damage taken back to the attacker.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the bigger damage is transferred back to the attacker.\\n\\nIn Jehrom and Thumiel's story of the Holy Scripture, a divine intervention occurs at the moment when faithful Jehrom is to be killed by his pagan brother Thumiel. Owing to the divine will, Jehrom's fatal wound is transferred to Thumiel while Jehrom is left without a scratch. This story of divine mercy was an inspiration to the spiritual thinkers who were discovering the secrets of divine magic and managed to find a magical formula which summons divine powers for the protection of the target of the spell transferring his wounds to the one who inflicted them.

This spell transfers the caster to a place where the Holy Ground spell was cast for the last time.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe casting time decreases with the increasing mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nDivine mercy is a fundamental of the Divine Magic, for it represents the basic metaphysical substrate this kind of magic is based on. It has all kinds of various manifestations and so there are many magical formulas of the Divine Magic which turn to it. One of the manifestations is the magical teleportation—a disappearance of the body of the target and its relocation to a different, safe place. The magical formula used can cumulate a huge amount of matter of the divine power and direct it in such a strong flow that it can relocate a body from place to place instantly.

This spell destroys all undead monsters which are the level lower than $$X$$. The surviving undead and demonic creatures are badly damaged during the duration of this spell.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect of this spell can become its target.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level of the caster, the more powerful undead this spell turns back to the underworld.\\n\\nA place sanctified according to the rite of the Holy Mother Church offers the faithful much better protection from all evil than any wall or palisade, for the ground sprinkled by the holy water and saturated with an eternal spiritual imprint of the religious ritual repels all evil and lessens the power of devil's servants. This well known fact led the spiritual thinkers to the examination of what was happening during the process of sanctifying a place which brought knowledge then used for the creation of a magical formula which in a single moment simulates the whole ritual of sanctifying the ground.

This spell will turn the target to a harmless lamb if the target's level is lower than the caster's level +$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Holy Scripture tells of the transubstantiation as of a manifestation of divine wrath which grows bigger with the type of crimes committed by the target of the divine wrath. For example, in the story of the treacherous Gangliel, the perfidious merchant is turned to an ass for choosing profit instead of mercy. This is an example of the change of a body of a human to a body of an animal as a means of just punishment. The Transubstantiation spell uses the same principle.

This spell resurrects one dead character from the player's party.\\n\\nThis spell affects only dead characters from the player's party.\\n\\nResurrection is one of the biggest miracles one can encounter both in the Holy Scripture and in the real life. With the help of divine mercy, a dead person can be brought back to life. The process of full revitalization of a human being includes the returning of his soul back to his body which means that it is not just a filthy activation of a dead body using a soul brought from the Afterworld by force. It is an act of truly divine love of human. The Resurrection spell is similar to the miracle and it is able to resurrect a person who is close with the caster using the psychological and spiritual bonds between the two.

This spell temporarily decreases Strength, Dexterity and Speed of the target by $$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the caster is, the more the attributes of the target decrease.\\n\\nThe heretical practitioners of the Pagan Magic studied the forbidden scriptures of Opiel Maxim, the mage and the alchemist of the Erebornian emperor, and found a formula able to put one in a state similar to the effects of overdose by narcotics, psychotropic substances and poisons. Opiel derived his abilities from pagan god Héroin whose kiss could bring about an ecstatic state of mind as well as painful death. The same spell nowadays uses the metaphysical imprint of faith in Héroin who survived the downfall of paganism and the rise of the true faith.

This spell temporarily increases Perception by 2*$$X$$.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe reaction bonus increases with the mastery level of the caster. The divine pantheon of pagan Erebornians included many gods and goddesses with many different abilities attributed to each of its single members. The god of wisdom and knowledge, to whom the wise men and scholars who need to stimulate their minds would turn, was called Brainus. Brainus's cult has survived until nowadays in the form of the Sense Improvement spell which stimulates the senses and logical thinking.

In case the target has been poisoned, this spell weakens the poison effects by $$X$$%.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Poison Resistance bonus and duration of this spell increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nAt the time of the pagan empire Ereborn, poison was a frequent and popular means of murder. It was being used on (and by) the emperors, their wives and concubines, the aristocracy, the commoners and everybody else. No wonder that poison was a main attribute of God Venomus who transported the dead over the river Mortis to the Afterworld. Naturally, the Erebornians paid a lot of attention to protection from poison. Praying to the Goddess Antimona, Venomus's wife who was able to tame him, was one of the ways. From the shards of the past knowledge, the heretics with the help of pagan rites managed to create a formula which summons the powers of dead Antimona and protects against the poison effects.

This spell temporarily increases the Armor Class of the target by 2*$$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Armor Class bonus and the duration of this spell increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe pagan myths speak many times of the Gorgons, the mysterious divine beings with a snakelike body and a bosom and a head of a woman. They were sisters who inherited immortality from their divine parents—with the exception of the youngest one whose name was Medusa. Unlike her sisters, she could turn any being that looked at her to stone. The ability appealed to the pagan thinkers and magicians and they tried to imitate it using magic. The result was surprising, although somewhat unexpected, because the target's skin gained the hardness of a stone for a short period of time. This spell was frequently used in the emperor's army and thanks to the voluminous essays written on it it has been preserved until nowadays.

This spell temporarily increases Strength and Chance to hit by $$X$$ while the defense and spell casting ability decrease.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of this spell increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nRuthus Denemius was a worldwide known Erebornian traveler who belonged to the few civilized people of his time to visit the distant Ice Plains and live there with the local barbaric tribes for some time. During his stay, he met the berserkers, feared warriors who were able to fall into a religious trance during which they became uncontrollably aggressive and hurled themselves at their enemies. The Erebornian court mages used this principle and created a spell which brings the target into a similar state increasing his strength but decreasing his defense. Thanks to the Hirkhan Scriptures, this spell has been preserved up to nowadays.

This spell opens any non-magically locked door, chest or barrel.\\n\\nAny non-magically locked door, chest or barrel can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana necessary to cast this spell successfully decreases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe pagan myths speak of a divine smith Hephaistos who was so strong that he could break a gate open with a single strike of a hammer. He was worshipped not only by smiths, armorers and metal crafters but also by soldiers and landsknechts as well, for his armor gave them strength. The worshipping became a fundamental of a spell which by thrust of an angry desire destroys any non-magically locked door, chest or barrel. Since the spell has frequently been used by the faithful army in 223 when the Erebornian Empire was overthrown, it has been preserved up to nowadays as an unfortunate form of pagan legacy.

This spell temporarily decreases the movement speed of the affected targets and Chance to hit of their missile attacks.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Chance to hit of missile attacks decreases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nOf the pantheon of the pagan gods, Poséidon was the lord of oceans and seas with the ability to control the whole water element. Reputedly, he was able to summon storms which crushed boats like eggshells and during which the waves were so high that they would swallow cities. These manifestations of divine power were used by the pagan magicians and a principle was extracted from them which gave birth to a formula that summons similar powers in the sea as well as on the ground. The original formula was almost forgotten after the downfall of Ereborn and it was only partially restored by the fallen priest Thárikulos. It nevertheless became a powerful tool in the hands of heretics inclined to pagan ways.

This spell gradually restores lost Hit Points.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast this spell decreases and speed of lost Hit Points regeneration increases with the higher mastery level of the caster. Also the duration of the spell is longer.\\n\\nThe pagan myths speak many times of the Gorgons, mysterious divine beings with the body of a snake and a chest and a head of a woman. They were sisters who inherited immortality from their divine parents. What made them immortal was the ability of perfect regeneration which not only prevented the sisters from aging but enabled them to heal the most severe wounds. Some pagans considered them divinities and worshipped them which often gave them strong healing and regenerating powers. The Regeneration spell, which has been preserved until nowadays thanks to the Eternal Beauties Order, uses the same principle.

This spell summons a few lightning balls which randomly move around causing Lightning Damage of 20d6 Hit Points.\\n\\nAny spot in the line of sight of the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nLightning was a frequent manifestation of divine wrath at the time of the Erebornian Empire. Unlike the true faith legends, where lightning as a manifestation of divine wrath appears as well, the pagan lightning was not lightning going from sky to the ground but rather a ball of lightning which would suddenly materialize by the sinner and burn him to ashes. A similar principle is used by this spell that concentrates energy with a quality of a ball of lightning on a single spot and thrusts it then against the opponent. This spell was a powerful weapon frequently used against the enemy even by the faithful armies fighting against Ereborn in 223 and despite church bans it has been preserved until nowadays.

This spell inflicts Fire Damage of 10d10+$$X$$ Hit Points per second during the time of its effect.\\n\\nAny being in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe legend of the sinful city of Narmazal which was burned down for turning away from the divine pantheon and felling for the seduction of demons is one of the most terrifying passages in the pagan mythology. The gods cast a rain of fire in this story which burned down the city and its inhabitants. Reportedly, the fire rained down from the sky for three days and three nights before the gods calmed down. The pagan mages were inspired by this manifestation of divine power which they studied and derived a formula from it that summons similar powers, although in smaller range. Since this spell was a powerful weapon, it was frequently being used against the enemy even by the faithful armies fighting against Ereborn in 223 and despite church bans it has been preserved until nowadays.

This spell temporarily increases Perception of the target by 2*$$X$$ and spell penetration by $$X$$.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe reaction bonus increases with the mastery level of the caster. Also regeneration of Mana is faster.\\n\\nOne of the miracles most frequently described in the Holy Scripture is Insight. It is an ability the prophets had to uncover pretense and hidden traps of both human and infernal origin with a single look. By thorough studies of the phenomena and many experiments, the thinkers who were focusing on this area of magic found a formula which gives one the Insight ability similar to the ability described in the Holy Scripture.

This spell causes $$X$$d6 points of Physical Damage.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe Holy Scripture says that a word of an angel can not only bring encouragement and consolation but pain and death as well. Thanks to divine mercy, the same ability was conveyed to the prophets and through the work of spiritual thinkers and church scholars studying this area of magic to all the faithful blessed with the gift of magic as well. This spell will magically multiply the resonance of words of divine wrath which inflicts damage on anyone the spell has been cast on.

This spell adds 1d6+$$X$$ of Fire Damage to each successful attack no matter what kind of weapon the caster uses.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of the spell increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe Holy Scripture speaks of several occasions when the Archangel Gabriel punished with his Sword of Flame a treacherous faithful who committed a crime against the Lord Creator and refused to repent. All the thirteen prophets were given the ability to turn their weapons to a flame of divine wrath which is the prolonged arm of the Archangel Gabriel himself. Only little effort was then needed to transform the ability to set a blade on fire to a magical formula and uncover it to all the magically talented faithful.

This spell inflicts $$X$$d3 points of Physical Damage per second during its effect.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe wounds inflicted by the summoned grasshoppers increase with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nMiracles are manifestations of divine grace as well as of divine wrath. Therefore the Holy Scripture speaks of miracles which punish those who refused to repent and went on living in a sin. An example of such a miracle is the prophet Ezechiel's summoning of a locust swarm at the village of Furae in the Gorgis desert whose inhabitants turned away from God after a disastrous series of famines and started to worship the pagan goddess of harvest Vesna instead. The grasshoppers ate the poor remains of their harvest as well as the cattle and the villagers themselves. Their bones stayed there for decades as a proof that believing in God is better than worshipping dead idols.

This spell allows the player and his party to walk over dangerous places such as chasms, lava and acid pools etc. Doors can be telekinetically opened by casting this spell on them. It is also possible to use this spell to pick up distant items.\\n\\nOnly the player and his party, a door or an item can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana needed to cast this spell decreases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nThe prophet Matheus, being a follower of the First Prophet, found himself in many dangerous situations in the course of his life and often managed to save his life only thanks to a miracle. At his visit of Kassmus city, the Erebornian soldiers pursued him for a mass he served to a river dock where they surrounded him. Matheus protected by his faith stepped on the water surface and miraculously crossed the river Bonthra on feet. That was the first known case of levitation which was then turned to a formula of the Magic of Miracles.

The target of this spell can't die in the course of its duration. If he looses his last Hit Point, the other wounds are subtracted from his Mana. However, the number subtracted from Mana is doubled. If the target looses all his Mana, the spell is cancelled and the target dies.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe duration of the spell increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nSalvation is the central idea of any religion. If one lives in humility, worships the Lord and resists the seduction of devil his soul will be redeemed and he will pass to the divine kingdom in heaven. So far, we have been speaking of the salvation of the soul. The Holy Scripture however speaks of situations when the life of a human being is miraculously saved. What happens is that physical and spiritual sides of a human interconnect and the wounds inflicted to the body are taken by the spiritual part instead. The Salvation spell uses the same principle.

This spell causes immediate Stamina loss of 3*$$X$$ points which are transformed to 2*$$X$$ Hit Points.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe amount of Hit Points added increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nSelf-sacrifice is considered to be the main theme of the true faith. The First Prophet sacrificed himself for all the humanity to redeem our sins by a martyr's death. The Holy Scripture speaks of many miracles which take place when somebody sacrifices himself for the true faith. The element of sacrifice and the appreciation which follows helped to create a magical formula which uses the spiritual state of mind in conjuction with the body to convert the sacrificed Stamina to the powers that heal the target.

Any being that attacks the caster of this spell takes 1d10 points of Physical Damage per second for the duration of this spell.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nThe damage inflicted to the enemy increases with the mastery level of the caster.\\n\\nA halo is a magical symbol of spiritual power, self-sacrifice, purity and above all the determination to spread the true faith all around the world thus contributing to the development of the Kingdom of God on Earth. Therefore the halo was granted not only to the angels, the prophets and the saints but to those who somehow made the true faith stronger as well. The halo makes its bearer untouchable and anyone who dares to confront him will be justly punished. A formula based on this principle was created which draws on the spiritual purity of the caster, multiplies it and turns it to the currents of power which wound anyone who dares to attack the caster.

This spell increases spell penetration by 2*$$X$$, gives the caster +$$X$$% bonus to all Resistances, increases Magic Resistance by 2*$$X$$ and improves the attack and the defence by 2*$$X$$.\\n\\nOnly the caster can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nAccording to the Holy Scripture, the angels are gifted with a miraculous spiritual and physical power which enables them to promote divine will amongst the mortals in case they encounter sin and heresy. The Archangel Gabriel has the biggest strength of them all, for he owns a sword of flames which weights as much as the sins of all humanity all together. That is why this spell, which can for a short period of time support both the body and the spirit of each protector of the divine order in his fight for keeping the Kingdom of God on Earth unspoiled, has been named after the Archangel Gabriel.

This spell causes 3*$$X$$d10 points of Lightning Damage to any being that stays in the area of effect. All non-magical doors and barrels in the surroundings are destroyed.\\n\\nAny being, door or barrel in the area of effect can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nDivine wrath is the most powerful and scariest miracle of which the Holy Scripture and many historical resources speak. It is frequently referred to as the Wrath of Heavens because it often comes from the divine kingdom in heavens. The formula evokes the same powers as those which caused the catastrophe described in the Shriva book—the Fall of Bandion and the destruction of Haptaran and Vennia. This spell gathers destructive powers, summoned by the just wrath of the caster and multiplied by the spiritual resonance of the formula, and channels them at his will.

Divine Magic includes spells that are the manifestations of divine powers, especially of healing and reinforcing ones. Divine Magic has its origins in the book Theologia Arcanea.\\n\\nThe spells of the Divine Magic are:\\n\\nBless (Novice)\\nEndurance (Novice)\\nSolid Faith (Novice)\\nRaise Dead (Student)\\nHealing Touch (Student)\\nLightning Protection (Student)\\nReflect Wounds (Student)\\nDivine Mercy (Initiate)\\nHoly Ground (Initiate)\\nTransubstantiation (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Magic of True Faith is based on the knowledge of true faith and its utilization in the battle against hellish forces. It includes defensive, reinforcing as well as offensive spells. Magic of True Faith has its origins in the book Adversum Maleficarum.\\n\\nThe spells of the Magic of True Faith are:\\n\\nFrost Protection (Novice)\\nCure Disease (Novice)\\nPurge (Novice)\\nProtection (Student)\\nShield of Faith (Student)\\nDispel Magic (Student)\\nLightning (Initiate)\\nExile (Initiate)\\nSpiritual Shield (Magister)\\nPillar of Salt (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Magic of Miracles follows the miracles that are attributed to the endless divine powers. It includes both reinforcing and offensive spells. Magic of Miracles has its origins in the book Diquisitiones Magicae.\\n\\nThe spells of the Magic of Miracles are:\\n\\nInsight (Novice)\\nWord of an Angel (Novice)\\nBlade of Fire (Novice)\\nLocust Swarm (Student)\\nLevitation (Student)\\nSalvation (Student)\\nSacrifice (Initiate)\\nHalo (Initiate)\\nArchangel's Power (Magister)\\nDivine Wrath (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Inquisitorial Magic is focused on the destruction of heretics and hellish monsters. It includes offensive spells especially. Inquisitorial Magic has its origins in the book Directorium Inquisitorum.\\n\\nThe spells of the Inquisitorial Magic are:\\n\\nSixth Sense (Novice)\\nOpen Wounds (Novice)\\nCurse (Novice)\\nLight (Student)\\nBlinding (Student)\\nCrucifixion (Student)\\nStoning (Initiate)\\nInvisibility (Initiate)\\nStigma (Magister)\\nTurn to Ashes (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Heretical Magic consists of spells and rituals of heretics fighting against the endless graciousness of Our Lord. It includes solely harmful and destructive spells. Heretical Magic has its origins in the forbidden book Liber Artum Magicarum Prohibitarum.\\n\\nThe spells of the Heretical Magic are:\\n\\nConfusion (Novice)\\nFear (Novice)\\nBreath of Death (Novice)\\nAstral Attack (Student)\\nSwarm of Flies (Student)\\nVampirism (Student)\\nDecay (Initiate)\\nPlague (Initiate)\\nInstant Death (Magister)\\nDance of the Dead (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Pagan Magic is based on the knowledge of pagan races and cultures that populated our world before the First Prophet. It includes defensive spells as well as stimulating, paralyzing and offensive spells. Pagan Magic has its origins in the forbidden book Elenchós Tés Pseudonymú Gnóseós.\\n\\nThe spells of the Pagan Magic are:\\n\\nOverdose (Novice)\\nKeen Senses (Novice)\\nPoison Protection (Novice)\\nStone Skin (Student)\\nBerserker (Student)\\nShatter (Student)\\nStorm (Initiate)\\nRegeneration (Initiate)\\nBall of Lightning (Magister)\\nRain of Fire (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

Infernal Magic follows the forbidden knowledge of hellish beings. It includes deuced dangerous spells, especially harmful and offensive ones. Infernal Magic has its origins in the forbidden book Liber Lucifer Ordinis Novi.\\n\\nThe spells of the Infernal Magic are:\\n\\nIntoxication (Novice)\\nFire Protection (Novice)\\nPoisonous Saliva (Novice)\\nInsanity (Student)\\nCrown of Thorns (Student)\\nFrost (Student)\\nPossession (Initiate)\\nInfernal Hounds (Initiate)\\nInfernal Flames (Magister)\\nDark Mass (Magister)\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nNovice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nStudent: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 15 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nInitiate: skill lvl 11; Int 38; lvl 35 (priest, thief)\\nMagister: skill lvl 16; Int 60; lvl 45 (priest)

The Melee Combat skill is used in an unarmed combat as well as in a combat with weapons used face to face; i.e. daggers, swords, axes, blunt weapons and pole arms.\\n\\nThe higher the mastery level is, the higher the Chance to hit is. Damage caused by the character increases as well.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Str 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Str 15; lvl 7 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Str 25; lvl 14 (paladin)\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Str 50; lvl 21 (paladin)

Ranged Combat is a skill which enables the character to kill an opponent by a throwing or ranged weapon. Unlike Melee Combat, it gives the character a chance to avoid direct contact with the opponent. A disadvantage is the need to restock ammunition (arrows, throwing daggers or axes) constantly.\\n\\nThe Chance to hit and the damage inflicted to the opponent increase with the mastery level of the character.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 15; lvl 7 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 25; lvl 15 (priest, thief)\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 50; lvl 21 (thief)

It is much safer to fight in armor than without it, there is no doubt about that. If one is affluent enough to be able to buy an armor, it is very likely that one day the investment will save his life.\\n\\nThe chance to reduce damage taken increases with the mastery level. Also the chance of receiving a Critical Hit and the clumsiness caused by wearing a heavy armor are reduced with the increasing mastery level.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Str 1; lvl 1 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Str 20; lvl 9 (priest, paladin, thief)\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Str 50; lvl 18 (paladin, thief)\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Str 70; lvl 27 (paladin)

This skill helps in discovering hidden traps, doors, buttons and places as well as small items such as rings, necklaces and other treasures.\\n\\nThe chance of discovering hidden objects increases with the mastery level. Also the damage inflicted by sprung traps and the Blindness penalty are reduced.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 10; lvl 6\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 20; lvl 12\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 40; lvl 24

Holy Aura is a skill all the priests of the Holy Mother Church can develop. It creates a permanent spiritual shield taking its energy from the true faith in God and protecting its bearer from danger. It is a gift the priests receive for taking the orders and a powerful weapon for those who are lead by their mission to the places where divine sight cannot see.\\n\\nThe chance for the priest to be hit by an attack or affected by a spell of an enemy decreases with the mastery level of the character. The magic defense of priest's enemies is lowered at the same time.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Str 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Str 14; lvl 9\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Str 26; lvl 18\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Str 38; lvl 36

Flagellantism is a peculiar skill previously banned by the Holy Council, for its roots lie in an originally heretical cult of the Flagellants—also known as The Whippers. The Whippers believed that self-torment was a way to make the world better and so they publicly exposed and whipped themselves to achieve that goal. Many of the flagellants were punished for heresy but as a part of the consolidation of the church at the end of the Hundred Year War, the Flagellant Cult was accepted by the church under the name of Saint Sebastian Order and whipping started to be performed as a means of strengthening the body and the spirit.\\n\\nThe pain tolerance of the priest increases with the mastery level, while fatigue penalty decreases and Fear Resistance increases. Also the chances that a Critical Hit will interrupt spell casting or an attack are lower.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Con 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Con 14; lvl 5\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Con 26; lvl 12\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Con 37; lvl 24

The authority of a priest is based on the respect he gains by his firm belief that he is performing God's will. It is an inner strength which is a shield for the priest's spirit and a support in his work. Not only the faithful have the respect but the heretics and hellspawns submit to it as well, although only against their will.\\n\\nWith the higher mastery level of the character the cowardice of his enemies increases. With every successful attack there is a chance that the enemy will flee in horror or will be paralyzed by fear. Also the effect of threatening is bigger when the priest uses it in a dialogue.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 20; lvl 9\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 50; lvl 18\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 70; lvl 37

Wisdom is the priest's strength. Thanks to their wisdom, the priests are able to absorb a lot of information and use it to increase their knowledge and understanding. This helps them understand and perform spells of all magical books.\\n\\nThe amount of Mana necessary to cast a spell and the Stamina loss when casting it decrease. The probability of successfully casting a spell increases and the time needed to restore energy after casting it decreases.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 18; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 46; lvl 22\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 66; lvl 38

For many centuries, alchemy was a field neglected by the clergy and only taken care of by the Royal Alchemist Guild, and if tolerated by the local bishops and governors also by folk seers and herbalists. Only in the 10th century did the brothers of Saint Fiono's Order start to study alchemy and the first discoveries came soon, especially when talking about mind and sanity affecting elixirs. Thanks to this, alchemy was accepted as a spiritual science by the Saint-Messia Council and soon became very popular with the clergy.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the potion maker is, the faster the effect of the potions which add Mana, Stamina and Health is. The maker is also able to make more difficult potions consisting of two, three or four different basic potions.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Con 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Con 12; lvl 8\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Con 24; lvl 16\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Con 39; lvl 29

Mana Restoration is a skill vital to any priest. It allows him to restore Mana using concentration which is however paid by a Stamina loss. Saint Orthenius, who always longed for an unlimited source of Mana because he did not like the idea that he could be left without power in his fight against heresy, is considered a discoverer of this ability.\\n\\nThe amount of Stamina lost when using this skill decreases with the mastery level of the priest, while the amount of Mana restored increases.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 16; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 33; lvl 26\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 57; lvl 40

Spiritual Insight is the most controversial of all the spiritual skills. It enables a character to connect his consciousness with the spiritual plane of existence which alchemists call the Astral World, thus gaining many supernatural powers. The problem of this skill is that while in the Astral World, the priest is deprived of his own sight while the Spiritual Insight skill cannot be terminated before its time to terminate comes.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the character is, the better supernatural powers the priest is gaining while in the Astral World: his intelligence increases, his ability to cast spells of all magical books improves and the duration of Spiritual Insight is longer.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 26; lvl 8\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 41; lvl 16\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 72; lvl 39

Faith is not the only thing that can protect a person from danger—in many cases a shield which protects from a deadly attack of a beast or a heretic, who cooks human insides in the cellar bellow his house and fornicates with black goats, helps as well. The founders of the Brotherhood of the Righteous realized this and decided that every member from the novice stage until his death shall be trained not only in weapon and armor use but in the fight with a shield as well.\\n\\nThis skill therefore improves the shield control. The higher the mastery level, the better the shield protects the knight. Also the chances of receiving a Critical Hit are lower.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Str 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Str 18; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Str 44; lvl 22\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Str 69; lvl 39

Sturdiness allows every paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous to be persistent in his fight against injustice. And the paladins cherish this skill, for it enables them to survive many bloody battles.\\n\\nThe maximum Hit Points increase when the paladin becomes an Apprentice, as well as when he is promoted to a Disciple, his Stamina increases after he is promoted to a Journeyman and his Poison Resistance increases when he becomes a Master because an experienced paladin cannot be poisoned easily.\\n\\n Mastery Levels:\\n\\n Apprentice: skill lvl 1; Con 1; lvl 1\\n Disciple: skill lvl 6; Con 15; lvl 9\\n Journeyman: skill lvl 11; Con 25; lvl 22\\n Master: skill lvl 16; Con 45; lvl 40

Holy Protection was adopted by the Brotherhood of the Righteous from the Holy Cross Order which has been developing it since the day it was founded. The principles of Holy Protection were reputedly discovered by a novice named Benjamin del Torra on his first crusade. The rumors have it that it was supposed to protect him from the lure of Jad-Habaal brothels. At the end, the spiritual training bore unexpected fruit which was a welcome contribution to the order and its holy mission.\\n\\nThe Magic, Fire, Frost and Lightning Resistances increase with the mastery level of the character.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Con 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Con 18; lvl 13\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Con 27; lvl 28\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Con 48; lvl 45

Estimation of an enemy is a useful skill which enables the paladins to discover strong and weak points of the opponent using their experience. They can then use the weaknesses to their own benefit. This makes an experienced paladin a more dangerous opponent than anybody else because such paladins know where to inflict a wound and when to retreat from the fight.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level of the paladin, the more qualities of the opponent he can estimate. Chance to hit, Armor Class and Chance to cast a spell increase as well.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 10; lvl 6\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 20; lvl 12\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 35; lvl 24

Divine Strike represents a conjunction of divine wrath and the strength of the paladin's arm, i.e. a conjunction of the spiritual and physical sides of justice. A paladin using the Divine Strike will boost his melee attack tremendously, which will however cost him twice as much Stamina.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the paladin is, the higher his chances are to score a Critical Hit which gives him the ability to stun his opponents.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 10; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 20; lvl 16\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 40; lvl 33

The paladins of the Brotherhood of the Righteous are being trained in combat since their novitiate, for combat is often the only way to enforce justice in the Realm. Combat, however, does not only require attack skills but defense skills as well. Therefore the latter receives as much attention as the former. He who can defend himself is more needed in battle than the famous barbarian berserkers.\\n\\nThe damage taken by the paladin gets smaller with the mastery level of the paladin but at the cost of a higher Stamina loss. The duration of the skill is longer as well and the chances of defending against an attack completely are higher. An otherwise deadly attack will not kill the paladin, it will only temporarily decrease his Chance to hit.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Spd 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Spd 18; lvl 8\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Spd 26; lvl 18\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Spd 36; lvl 34

Smithing is an indispensable part of war craft. Therefore the paladins of the Brotherhood of the Righteous are frequently skilled in it. The protection of justice in the Realm cannot be stopped because a paladin's sword got broken or because a part of his armor fell off. And without the Smithing skill, the enforcement of justice would be dependent on gold paid to the smiths for the repair of broken equipment.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the character is, the more complicated armor and weapons he can repair.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Con 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Con 10; lvl 11\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Con 20; lvl 25\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Con 40; lvl 41

Eloquence is a skill that can do miracles—it can improve one's reputation, lower the prices of items in the shops, ease persuasion in a dialogue and get one of any trouble. It is no wonder that eloquence is practiced mainly by people who often find themselves in problematic situations.\\n\\nThe higher the mastery level is, the higher reputation bonus the character gets. It also affects prices in the shops—of the items bought as well as of the ones sold. The effect of threatening in dialogues improves and if a reputation loss occurs, it is lowered by the eloquence of the character.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 15; lvl 16\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 25; lvl 29\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 36; lvl 41

Agility is good both for the body and the mind—says an old saying. And this is especially true when a deadly attack which could separate the soul from the body eternally occurs. Dodging from a brutal attack is a useful skill anybody who finds himself in situations often solved by violence can use.\\n\\nThe chances of dodging an attack increase with the mastery level of the character. Higher level characters are able to wound an enemy while defending and confuse him completely by a clever maneuver.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 22; lvl 12\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 39; lvl 22\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 72; lvl 44

Ambush is not only a crime punishable by death, or at least by chopping off a hand, it is also a skill useful for those who like to do... well... surprise attacks. It is a tricky maneuver when the assailant takes advantage of the fact that the victim does not know about his presence, and inflicts wounds much worse than if the victim had defended.\\n\\nThe Chance to hit and the damage inflicted increase with the mastery level of the character. The chances of inflicting a Critical Hit and an instant kill are higher as well.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 20; lvl 10\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 40; lvl 20\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 70; lvl 35

Stealth allows a character to become almost invisible to all who do not pay attention. The character uses shadows and terrain features as well as his spiritual ability to look like he is not there. It is, however, quite an exhausting activity and costs the character some Stamina.\\n\\nStealth of the character increases with his mastery level. Also the Stamina demand is lower and the probability that the character will stay hidden even when somebody is watching him increases. At high levels, the character is able to stay hidden even after casting a spell or attacking an enemy. The overall duration of stealth is longer as well.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 18; lvl 14\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 36; lvl 26\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 62; lvl 40

Stealing is a filthy crime and nobody can say otherwise. However, it is also self-evident that it is a useful skill which gives one many opportunities. It happens to everybody sometimes that they long for something which belongs to somebody else. Unfortunately, only truly skilled thieves can attempt to steal something really valuable and get away with it if they get caught.\\n\\nWith the increasing mastery level, the thief gains new opportunities—he can steal not only on the streets but in the shops as well and there is a greater chance he will not be discovered when he makes an unsuccessful attempt.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 22; lvl 9\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 44; lvl 18\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 74; lvl 36

Thieving is a useful skill which allows one to open locked doors and chests and to remove traps. This skill can be used for doing good deeds as well, but it was called after the more frequent way in which it is used. No matter for what purpose one uses this skill, one must count on the fact that it will cost him a lot of energy.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the character is, the less time he needs to open a lock or remove a trap, and the less energy it takes.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Dex 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Dex 15; lvl 6\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Dex 26; lvl 12\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Dex 50; lvl 24

The Magical Attack skill allows a character to interconnect the body and the mind for a short period of time and to launch an attack which not only causes physical damage but certain magical damage as well. It can be Fire, Lightning, Frost or Poison damage. Such an attack will cost the character some Mana though.\\n\\nThere is a dispute lead within the Holy Mother Church of how it is possible that laics have such supernatural powers when their faith—which is usually considered to be the only source of magical powers—is minimal. Also, heretical theories emerged saying that supernatural powers of human beings do not come from faith but rather from a state of mind.\\n\\nThe higher mastery level the character is, the bigger magical damage is inflicted and the less Mana is consumed. Also the duration of the skill is longer.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 14; lvl 7\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 28; lvl 14\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 40; lvl 35

This skill is used for identification of items. It helps to find out what kind of object it is, and what are its qualities and possible magical attributes. If one does not have this skill, he must leave the identification to merchants who are not likely to do it for free.\\n\\nThe chances of a successful identification of an item increase with the mastery level of the character. The character also gains the ability to identify more difficult objects such as scrolls, seals, artifacts or relics.\\n\\nMastery Levels:\\nApprentice: skill lvl 1; Int 1; lvl 1\\nDisciple: skill lvl 6; Int 15; lvl 7\\nJourneyman: skill lvl 11; Int 25; lvl 12\\nMaster: skill lvl 16; Int 40; lvl 25
